articleTitle: Optical jitter due to refractive index variations in slow-light photonic crystal MZI switches
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High effective index waveguides can reduce the size of integrated active MZIs significantly. We demonstrate numerically that they have high sensitivity to variations in material refractive index leading to significant pulse distortion due to jitter.

articleTitle: Two-photon spectral coherency matrix and multi-parameter optical entanglement
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce the concept of two-photon spectral coherency matrix and the spectral two-photon Stokes parameters as a counterpart to the classical coherency matrix of broadband polarized light. We discuss its use for characterizing frequency-polarization optical entanglement.

articleTitle: Green and ultraviolet pulse generation using a low-repetition-rate mode-locked Yb-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a compact 1-μm mode-locked fiber source, we demonstrate 2nd harmonic generation (540 nm) of 0.4 W and 4th harmonic generation (270 nm) of 0.1 W with subpicosecond pulse durations.

articleTitle: "Instantaneous" frequency shift of a high Q planar photonic crystal microcavity mode
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high Q mode in a silicon planar photonic crystal microcavity is dynamically perturbed by injection of free carriers, and modelled by a damped harmonic oscillator which undergoes an instantaneous frequency and lifetime shift.

articleTitle: Chirp-dependent above-threshold ionization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By solving the three-dimensional Schrödinger equation for the sodium and hydrogen atoms we demonstrate that the above-threshold ionization spectra strongly depend on the chirprates of fs laser pulses.

articleTitle: Development of a clock laser of Ca+ Ion for the optical frequency standards
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A narrow linewidth diode laser is being developed. The laser linewidth is reduced to 66 Hz. The long term frequency drift is reduced 0.5 Hz per second, measured by Gigajet 20W optical frequency comb

articleTitle: Chiral-selective excitation of lattice vibrations in carbon nanotubes using femtosecond pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiple pulse trains produced by femtosecond pulse shaping were used for chiral-selective excitation of coherent radial breading modes (RBM) in carbon nanotubes. Detection scheme and chirality-dependent phonon lifetimes are discussed.

articleTitle: Multiple input and random medium information retrieval from second order intensity correlations
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that relative delay and intensity information with two sources incident on a random medium can be retrieved from second order frequency intensity correlations. This interferometer may prove important in imaging applications.

articleTitle: Nonlinear carrier waves and gain oscillations in infrared and terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The pump pulse induced charge dynamics in quantumcascade laser structures is analyzed for typical examples of infrared and terahertz lasers in pump-probe spectra and electronic wave packet propagation using a density-matrix approach.

articleTitle: Echo peak shift spectroscopy of quantum well excitons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-pulse four-wave-mixing is used to observe the loss of optical phase memory in an inhomogeneous quantum well. The system's ability to form a photon echo is almost entirely lost due to spectral diffusion of excitons.

articleTitle: Enhanced coherent thermal emission of coupled resonant cavities due to surface phonon-polariton excitation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally show a quasi-monochromatic and directional thermal source with a spatial coherence length in the far-field that is much larger than the predicted limit related to the surface phonon-polariton coherence of a flat surface.

articleTitle: Local field enhancement and spectral response of resonant nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The resonant behavior of metallic nano-structures is simulated using local mesh refinement of the FDTD method in 3 Dimensions. The influence of shape and tip geometry on the resonance structure and intensity of the optical fields is examined.

articleTitle: Collision of orthogonally polarized solitons in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study experimentally the propagation and collision of two orthogonally polarized solitons in a weakly-birefringent photonic crystal fiber. The collision occurs at a particular power and initiates energy transfer between the colliding solitons.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic interaction between nanoparticles and optical subwavelength devices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A general approach to self-consistently describe the electromagnetic field in a nanophotonic environment is presented. It is applied to dielectric particles and quantum-dots in the optical subwavelength-limit and also yields the radiative force on them.

articleTitle: Gain filtering for single-spatial-mode operation of large-mode-area fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gain filtering of higher-order modes in large-mode-area fibers is an extremely robust method for providing diffraction-limited performance regardless of core diameter or input-beam quality. These predictions extend to 100-μm cores to the 10-kW level.

articleTitle: Explicit formulae for the medium parameters of optically-active molecules and crystals from the microscopic theory
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dyadic formulae for the medium parameters of the electromagnetic point-localized constitutive relations from the microscopic theory of optically-active molecules and crystals have been newly found, which clears out long-held controversy on reciprocity and equivalence

articleTitle: Quantum efficiency of self-assembled quantum dots determined by a modified optical local density of states
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured time-resolved spontaneous emission from quantum dots near a dielectric interface with known photonic local density of states. We thus experimentally determine the quantum efficiency and the dipole moment, important for quantum optics.

articleTitle: Photon pair generation in reverse-proton-exchange lithium niobate waveguides with mode demultiplexing at a pump repetition rate of 10 GHz
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report correlated photon pair generation in periodically-poled reverse-proton- exchange lithium niobate waveguides with mode demultiplexing using 10-ps-long laser pulses at a repetition rate of 10 GHz. We observed a visibility as high as 167.

articleTitle: Characterization of skin incision closure using diode laser and ICG -albumin protein solder
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical and thermal parameters are optimized for an invitro skin closure using a 10W diode laser at 800 nm. The major results showed the effects of static and dynamic modes of treatments on tissue tensile strength.

articleTitle: Laser based continuous-wave excitonic Lyman spectroscopy of spin-forbidden excitons in Cu2O
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a sensitive method to detect 1s paraexcitons in Cu2O by using cw laser-based excitonic Lyman spectroscopy with a tunable CO2 laser. The paraexcitons were found to have a lifetime of microseconds.

articleTitle: Experimental quantum key distribution with active phase randomization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phase-randomization is an important assumption in many security proofs of practical quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. Here, we present the first experimental QKD with reliable active phase-randomization. A polarization-insensitive phase-modulator is designed for our experiment.

articleTitle: Near-field characterization of plasmon polariton propagation along periodically nano-structured metal thin films
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We operate a near-field optical microscope to investigate the properties of periodically nano-structured metal thin films designed to control at the micron scale the propagation or the excitation of surface plasmon polaritons.

articleTitle: Improvement of the efficiency of laser cooling using type II multiple QW's
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Type II multiple quantum wells exhibit strong anti-Stokes shift of the fluorescence. This phenomenon can used to achieve laser cooling with efficiency increased by a factor of few compared to bulk.

articleTitle: Estimation of refractive index distribution inside transparent materials by use of four-wave mixing process
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By focusing a femtosecond laser pulse and measuring the resultant four-wave mixing (FWM) signal, we successfully estimate refractive index distribution inside a transparent sample based on the analytical expression for FWM intensity and refractive index.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulse compression in the extreme ultraviolet region by conical diffraction
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A grating compressor for attosecound pulses in the extreme-ultraviolet region is presented. The instrument design and the phase properties are discussed.

articleTitle: Linear electro-optic coefficient in multilayer self-organized InAs quantum dot structures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The electro-optic coefficients of self-organized InAs quantum dot layers in molecular beam epitaxy grown laser structures in reverse bias have been investigated. Enhanced electrooptic coefficients compared to bulk GaAs were observed.

articleTitle: Dispersive shock waves in optical lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study dispersive shock waves in optical lattices. We characterize shock propagation as a function of lattice depth and observe nonlinear coupling between different Bloch modes of the array.

articleTitle: Photonic force microscopy with back-scattered light
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare the sensitivity of the Photonic Force Microscope for the forward-scattering and backward-scattering geometries, calculating the total-scattered electromagnetic field from a dielectric bead in an optical trap using a Mie-Debye approach.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional characterisation of the non-gaussian focused beam from a terahertz quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A fast, accurate technique for the three-dimensional characterisation of terahertz beams is presented. Using gold-on-glass resolution targets the beam profile, depth of focus and astigmatism of a quantum cascade laser-based imaging system have been measured.

articleTitle: Multi-photon route to ultraviolet nanowire lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multi-photon absorption pumped ultraviolet ZnO nanolasers were demonstrated with femtosecond pulses at room temperature. Time resolved photoluminescence revealed that the exciton collision effect played an important role in the nonlinear lasing mechanisms.

articleTitle: Multi-functional video-rate optical coherence tomography microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A swept source OCT system capable of simultaneous imaging sample structural and blood flow information is demonstrated. This system has 3-D imaging capability which combines the advantages of OCT and microscopy in a single system.

articleTitle: Analytic model of rotational wave packet excitation with arbitrary pump polarization in the impulsive limit
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An analytic model for non-resonant rotational wave packet excitation in linear molecules by intense ultrafast elliptically polarized laser pulses in the impulsive limit is presented

articleTitle: Generation and characterization of femtosecond petawatt Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Ti:sapphire laser with output of 0.89PW/29.0fs based on the scheme of chirped pulse amplification has been developed. The high gain amplification was achieved in large aperture amplifiers by effective suppression of parasitic lasing.

articleTitle: Site-selectivity and spin exchange in a double-well optical lattice
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated site-selective radio frequency addressing of atoms with subwavelength resolution and a spin-exchange mechanism for a square root of swap gate in a spindependent double-well optical lattice.

articleTitle: Multipartite entanglement in non-equilibrium quantum phase transition in a collective atomic system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study multipartite entanglement in non-equilibrium quantum phase transition in a coherently driven atomic ensemble undergoing collective decay.

articleTitle: High current permanent discharges in air induced by femtosecond laser filamentation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Filaments created in air by an intense femtosecond laser pulse in the presence of an electric field generate a highly conductive permanent plasma column.

articleTitle: Spectral properties of entangled-photons generated via type-I spontaneous parametric downconversion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Complete measurement of single-photon and two-photon joint spectral properties of entangled photon pairs generated via type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion under different phase-matching conditions are reported. A theoretical model is also developed to explain the observed two-photon joint spectra.

articleTitle: Directional Output from GaAs micro-stadium lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed the directional output from GaAs micro-stadium lasers at low temperature, by the scatted emission on a ring enclosure structure. Our numerical simulation shows the directionality of the laser emission fit classical ray dynamics.

articleTitle: Scalable quantum networks with atoms and photons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Scalable quantum networks for quantum computation, communication, and metrology require new capabilities for interfacing quantum states of matter and light. I will provide an overview of recent theoretical and experimental progress in this area.

articleTitle: Generation of isolated sub-100-as XUV pulses using time-gate assisted few-cycle driving pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new approach to generating sub-100-as XUV pulses using time-gate assisted few-cycle driving pulses. Simulations show that the gate beam suppresses one electron trajectory, resulting in single electron trajectory in one driving cycle.

articleTitle: Long-range spin-qubit interaction in planar microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study theoretically the coupling between localized spins mediated by itinerant polaritons in a planar micro-cavity. Due to their photon-like mass, polaritons provide an extremely long spin-coupling range, useful for the realization of two-qubit operations.

articleTitle: Enhanced cascade ξ(2) SHG+DFG interactions based on chirp period quasi-phase-matched waveguide
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A theoretic study about a 170% conversion efficiency enhancement of cascade ξ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> SIIG+DFG interactions by using a c h i period quasi-phase-matched waveguide.

articleTitle: Corrugated plasma waveguide: Slow wave structure for high intensity optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Up to 4 cm long corrugated plasma waveguides are generated in clustered hydrogen, nitrogen, and argon gas jets. The corrugation period is as short as 70μm with relative modulation amplitudes up to ~20%.

articleTitle: Time-resolved photoluminescence of GaN nanowires of different crystallographic orientations
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our studies of time-integrated and time-resolved photoluminescence of a-axis and c-axis GaN nanowires demonstrate that the blue-shifted ultraviolet photoluminescence in a-axis GaN nanowires relative to c-axis GaN nanowires can be attributed to surface state emission.

articleTitle: Single-mode surface-emitting terahertz quantum-cascade lasers operating up to ~ 150 K
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report robust single-mode operation of surface-emitting distributed-feedback terahertz quantum-cascade lasers in metal-metal waveguides. Grating devices span a range of 0.35THz around 2.9THz, with 149K maximum pulsed operating temperature, and >6mW continuous-wave power at 5K.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical studies of exciton correlations using optical two-dimensional fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Many-body correlations of excitons in semiconductors are explored experimentally with two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy and modeled by a microscopic coherent x(3) theory beyond the Hartree-Fock approximation with qualitative agreements under different excitation conditions.

articleTitle: Pulse propagation near exciton resonance: Anomalous transition between slow and fast light
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental studies of optical pulse propagation near exciton absorption resonance in an optically thick GaAs quantum well reveal an anomalous transition between regimes of slow and fast light.

articleTitle: Observation of the dark states of near-field coupled InAs quantum dots using optical near-field microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed the dark states of coupled InAs quantum dots via an optical near-field. The experimental results show that the dipoles of near-field coupled InAs quantum dots are distributed with an anti-parallel configuration.

articleTitle: Optimizing contrast of tip-enhanced fluorescence microscopy for imaging high-density samples
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum dots are imaged using tip-enhanced fluorescence microscopy. Optimization of the operation parameters leads to high-contrast images of high-density samples and a novel photon analysis improves contrast further.

articleTitle: High order-mode coupling in a fiber Bragg grating by flexural acoustic-wave modulations
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: When two acoustic flexural waves with appropriate frequencies are launched to a tilted fiber Bragg grating, high-order acousto-optic modulations can be greatly improved by superimposing high-order harmonic acoustic waves.

articleTitle: Interferometric Tiling of large-aperture gratings for Petawatt laser systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tiled-grating assembly with three large-scale gratings is developed with real-time interferometric tiling control for a petawatt laser system. Tiling-parameters sensitivity and focal-spot degradation are analyzed for a compressor composed of four such assemblies.

articleTitle: Theory of optical refrigeration in p-doped semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic theory for luminescence of doped GaAs and its application to a study of optical refrigeration. We find that p-doping affects the temperature dependence of the cooling threshold in a complex way.

articleTitle: A high-power, single-frequency Ti:Sapphire laser for water-vapor DIAL
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high-power Ti:Sapphire ring laser with injection seeding at 820 nm is presented. Pumping a Brewster-cut crystal with 23-W pump power at 532 nm resulted in single-frequency operation with average power of 6 W.

articleTitle: Resonant energy transfer due to exciton-exciton interaction in the strong coupling regime in Hybrid InGaN Quantum Wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Resonant coupling of excitons in strongly confined hybrid perovskite conjugated to InGaN quantum wells is observed. Temperature and time-resolved-photoluminescence (PL) reveal 10 times enhancement of recombination lifetime in strong-coupling regime due to resonant energy transfer.

articleTitle: Radiation dose enhancement in photonic crystal fiber bragg gratings: towards photo-ionization monitoring of irradiation sources in harsh nuclear power reactors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using kinetic-based models we show that photonic crystal fiber Bragg gratings (PCFBGs) can exhibit enhanced dose-rate absorption capabilities, in comparison to conventional BGs. The modeling aims to assess the physical-mechanisms defining the response to nuclear-radiation.

articleTitle: Attosecond technology and wavefunction tomography
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We will review recent experimental progress in the generation and characterization of attosecond pulses, and in wavefunction tomography using re-collision electron wavepackets produced by tunnel ionization in a strong laser field.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of SHG efficiency in periodically-twinned QPM quartz
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examined second harmonic generation efficiency depending on input polarization state of the fundamental wave in crystal-quartz wavelength converter. We found the optimum polarization state for efficient SHG at 532 nm.

articleTitle: The difference between a photon's momentum and an atom's recoil
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyze the recoil shift for atoms in Gaussian laser beams and microwave cavities. The frequency shifts from the transverse photon recoils must be understood for the most accurate atom interferometers and atomic fountain clocks.

articleTitle: Momentum distribution dynamics of a tonks-girardeau gas: Bragg reflections of a quantum many-body wavepacket
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dynamics of the momentum distribution and the reduced single-particle density matrix (RSPDM) of a Tonks-Girardeau gas is studied in the context of Bragg-reflections of a manybody wavepacket.

articleTitle: Toward 3D microfluidic structures fabricated with two-photon laser machining
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a method to fabricate 31) microfluidic systems with two-photon polymerization in SU-8 photoresist. This approach will be an easy and accurate way to fabricate microfluidic systems simulating complex microstructures.

articleTitle: Revisiting chirped probe pulse electro-optic terahertz detection
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The correct equation for terahertz pulse detection schemes employing a chirped optical probe pulse is derived and experimentally verified. The derived equation differs from the conventional expression through a phase factor.

articleTitle: Novel distributed fiber temperature and strain sensor using coherent radio-frequency detection of spontaneous Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel technique that enables coherent detection of spontaneous Brillouin scattering in radio-frequency region has been demonstrated for distributed measurements of temperature and strain in long fiber by using a CW single-frequency Brillouin fiber laser.

articleTitle: Effects of dispersion on the optical drag effect in a laser gyro
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The classical Fresnel form of optical drag coefficient is rederived for rotating dispersive media. Implications for the active ring laser gyro are considered, with strong enhancement of sensitivity near the points of critical anomalous dispersion.

articleTitle: Terahertz imaging
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The methods, instrumentation, and application of time domain terahertz imaging (a.k.a. THz or T-Ray Imaging) for non-destructive evaluation (NDE) and security are discussed.

articleTitle: Spectral loss characteristics of subwavelength THz fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: From the spectral loss characteristics of subwavelength-diameter THz fibers, our study supports the recent theory proposed by M. Sumetsky that diameter-variation-induced-radiation is a dominant loss mechanism for subwavelength fibers which limits the lowest guidable frequency.

articleTitle: BAND sensor for biodefense
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: SAIC's BAND sensor is an automated system for collecting and analyzing urban air samples to detect airborne biological threats. Microbial threat detection uses highly-multiplexed PCR with microarray fluorescence readout. Toxin detection employs an antibody assay.

articleTitle: Intra-molecular dynamics probed using high-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonic generation is used to probe vibrational and electronic dynamics in small molecules. We impulsively excite vibrations in CF3C1 and observe oscillations in the harmonic emission. We electronically excite CF3I and observe changes in the yield.

articleTitle: Spins in quantum dot molecules
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Through optical spectroscopy of Quantum Dot Molecules we observe spin interactions and gfactors that depend on electric field. We describe how these effects could be used to control spin states and optically gate spin interactions.

articleTitle: Realization of Loschmidt echo in atom optics billiard
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Loschmidt echo of atoms trapped in atom optics billiards with chaotic and mixed dynamics is realized by performing a microwave Ramsey sequence to their internal state.

articleTitle: Cooling atoms in a bistable optical resonator
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a generic approach for nonresonant laser cooling of atoms/molecules based on their interaction with a bistable optical cavity. The cooling mechanism is of Sisyphus type, and it does not require high-finesse cavities.

articleTitle: Reducing the fast carrier-envelope phase jitter of amplified femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stabilizing the interference signal obtained from co-propagating a HeNe beam in the f-to-2f interferometer used for carrier-envelope phase stabilization of a femtosecond laser oscillator reduced the fast phase jitter of the amplified pulses by ~40%.

articleTitle: Two-photon based semiconductor entanglement-source for quantum communications
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a compact efficient room-temperature polarization-entangled photons source based on two-photon spontaneous emission from semiconductor quantum wells in a microcavity. Pair generation rate in GaInP/AlGaInP is O(103) higher than for PDC sources.

articleTitle: Generation of simultaneous red, green and blue light in periodically poled lithium niobate with broad quasi-phase matching band
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated simultaneous red, green and blue light generation in periodically poled lithium niobate pumped with single picosecond laser. The primary color peaks were temperature-insensitive owing to broadband optical parametric generation of participating infrared frequencies.

articleTitle: Electrical conductivity measurements of warm dense matter with time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The quasi-DC electrical conductivity of warm dense matter is directly measured with terahertz-probe reflection spectroscopy. The measurements show a noticeable deviation from the Drude model in warm dense aluminum.

articleTitle: Very low-threshold-current-density 1.34-μm GaInNAs/GaAs quantum well lasers with a quaternary-barrier structure
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quaternary-barrier structure is employed to reduce the strain at the interface between the quantum well and barriers for GaInNAs/GaAs materials. A very-low room-temperature threshold current density of 178A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is demonstrated with 1.34-μm GaInNAs/GaAs lasers.

articleTitle: Coherent nonlinear optical effects in semiconductor QWs induced by intense single-cycle THz pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate coherent THz-induced dynamics for optical excitation in semiconductor quantum-wells via THz-pump and optical-probe experiments. Strong single-cycle THz pulses induce transient spectral-shifts and broadening of the light-hole and heavy-hole excitonic resonances in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum-wells.

articleTitle: Pulse broadening or compression in fast-light pulse propagation through an erbium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulse broadening or compression in an Er3+-doped fiber amplifier is observed, and explained by gain recovery and pulse spectrum broadening effects. Maximal pulse advancement and minimal pulse distortion are obtained by optimizing these competing effects.

articleTitle: Spectral phase control of remote surface-plasmon-mediated two-photon-induced luminescence
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of spectral phase modulation as a mechanism for control over surface-plasmon-mediated two-photon-induced luminescence at distances tens of microns from the focal spot of a femtosecond laser.

articleTitle: Entangled photon generation from a single quantum dot in microcavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A biexciton plays only a minor role in entangled photon generation fkom a quantum dot in microcavity. The rate of entangled photons becomes almost 100% due to the photon blockade in the strong-coupling regime.

articleTitle: Refractive Gauss-to-Tophat beam shapers improve structure quality and speed in micro-machining
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The transformation principle of a Gaussian beam into a homogeneous top-hat profile by means of free-form refractive micro-optics is reviewed. Various flat-top profiles achieved with different laser sources as well as micro-machining results are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cascaded two wavelength lasers and their effects on C-band amplification performance for Er3+-doped fluoride fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report cascaded two-wavelength 853nm and 1533nm lasing from Er3+-doped fluoride fiber pumped at 974nm. A new way to get high efficiency and low noise C-band amplifier is suggested for Er3+-doped fibers with low phonon energy.

articleTitle: Theoretical study of mutual injection locking of two individual lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mutual injection-locking of two individual lasers through an external combining section was theoretically studied. We found that larger lockable range can be obtained with lower Q-factors for individual lasers.

articleTitle: Complete physical simulation of the entangling-probe attack on the BB84 protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have implemented the most powerful individual-photon attack against the Bennett-Brassard 1984 quantum key distribution protocol. Our measurement results are in good agreement with theoretical predictions for the eavesdropper's Rényi information.

articleTitle: A new compact polarization beam splitter based on dual-elliptical-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on a vectorial boundary element method and the normal mode coupled theory, there is an optimum design for achieving a compact polarization splitter with broad extinction ratio bandwidth by adjusting only one parameter.

articleTitle: Minimizing non-radiative losses in erbium laser systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Very low rates of excited-state absorption and upconversion were measured from the 4I13/2 level in Er3+ doped KPb2Cl5 crystals. Comparisons with other hosts suggest significant potential improvements in laser performance.

articleTitle: Adaptive sub-wavelength control of nanoscopic fields
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We combine two previously separated research fields, adaptive control and nano-optics, to achieve dynamic localization of electromagnetic intensity at sub-wavelength nanoscopic spatial resolution. This is demonstrated experimentally with femtosecond polarization shaping and photoemission electron microscopy.

articleTitle: Single-shot observation of quasi-continuum high-harmonic spectrum generated in a two-color driving field
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the single-shot observation of quasi-continuum high-harmonic spectrum with a harmonic energy of 10 nJ in the XUV region by using a two-color laser field. It indicates a possibility of generating single attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Novel Full-color Photorefractive Polymer for Photonics Applications
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Full-color sensitive (488nm, 532nm, 633nm) photorefractive polymer system based on hole-transport polytetraphenyldiaminobiphenyl (TPD) is present. Several novel dynamic holographic applications have been demonstrated based on these materials.

articleTitle: Improved acousto-optic modulator for ultrafast laser pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an improved acousto-optic modulator for ultrafast optical pulse shaping making use of a diamond shaped transducer. Measurements of the spatial profile of the diffracted light beam agree well with Fresnel diffraction calculations.

articleTitle: A novel anti-reflecton coated FP laser amplifier for 2.5Gbit/s DWDM-PON transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel anti-reflection coated Fabry-Perot laser amplifier under side-mode injection-locking for 2.5Gbit/s DWDM-PON is demonstrated with SMSR >35dB, Q-factor 9.2, locking range of 30nm, power penalty of -0.7dB, and BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> at -23.7dBm.

articleTitle: New developments in strongly interacting fermi gases
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present new results on collective excitation modes of a gas of 6Li atoms in the BEC-BCS crossover, and we report on our first results on interactions in a Fermi-Fermi mixture of 6Li and 40K atoms.

articleTitle: Temporal soliton molecules: Experimentally determined phase profiles
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Temporal soliton molecules in dispersion-managed fibers are characterized with an advanced FROG technique. This technique reveals phase and power profiles for complex pulse shapes where conventional techniques fail.

articleTitle: Low loss, low dispersion T-ray transmission in microwires
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present low loss, < 0.01 1/cm, and dispersion, < 10 ps/(km.nm), properties of microwires for terahertz transmission. These wires have diameters smaller than the operating wavelength, resulting in the propagation of enhanced evanescent fields.

articleTitle: Can we fabricate efficient white-light InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diode without using phosphors?
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report some recent developments in all-semiconductor multi-color and white-light light-emitting diodes. The potential of the development of phosphor-free all-InGaN/GaN quantum-well white-light light-emitting diode will be evaluated.

articleTitle: Characterizing a bright two-photon source using a polarization-maintaining microstructure fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: After characterizing the Raman scattering spectrum of a polarization-maintaining microstructure fiber, we produced a high brightness two-photon source with a two-photon coincidence/accidental (C/A) ratio of 1000 at 100 Hz.

articleTitle: Injection of electrons into plasma waves by colliding laser pulses into an underdense plasma
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Controlled injection of electrons into a laser-plasma accelerator is achieved by colliding two counterpropagating laser pulses into a plasma, It results in monoenergetic, high quality, stable and tuneable electron beams (from 15 to 300 MeV).

articleTitle: Limits of strong mode confinement in microdisk terahertz quantum-cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present microdisk terahertz quantum-cascade lasers with dimensions comparable to the spatial mode distribution inside the microcavity and present 3D Finite-Difference Time-Domaine simulations which are in good agreement with our experimental findings.

articleTitle: Biological substance characterization in water matrices with raman microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Raman microspectroscopy is investigated for spectral information from bacteria and protein biological substances in distilled and tap water matrices. Laser energy flux, multivariate dataspace biological differentiation, and substance aging in water matrices were investigated.

articleTitle: Experimental production of pure single-photon states
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Parametric downconversion in KDP provides a method of producing heralded single photons in pure states.We present the theory behind this technique and our most recent experimental results.

articleTitle: Monitoring vibrational wave packet dynamics via direct femtosecond pump-probe measurements
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond pump-probe measurements are shown to reveal the evolution of excited vibrational wave packets in CS2 through the probe transmission modulation. Frequency-resolved acquisition allows for selective monitoring of different subsets of the Raman transitions excited.

articleTitle: Ultracold atoms in optical lattice - from precision measurement to quantum optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultracold atoms confined in an optical lattice offer an ideal platform for quantum manipulation and precision measurement. We report our latest results using fermionic isotope of Sr.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral imaging detection of CBE threat materials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Chemical imaging, a multi-mode hyperspectral imaging approach combining Raman, fluorescence and NIR spectroscopies, is being evaluated for point and standoff detection of chemical, biological and explosive (CBE) threats. Results from sponsored studies will be presented.

articleTitle: Superfluid ultracold fermi gases
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have explored several aspects of superfluidity of ultracold fermionic atoms, including superfluidity of rotating clouds, of clouds with an imbalance in the population of the two components, and of atoms in an optical lattice.

articleTitle: Super mode propagation in low index medium
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate a novel waveguide geometry consisting of a high dielectric medium adjacent to a metal plane with a thin low dielectric spacer. The mechanism of operation is explained and simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Differential near-field scanning optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new aperture-type near-field scanning optical microscopy (NSOM) technique, termed differential NSOM (DNSOM) is illustrated. DNSOM utilizes sharp corners of an aperture to beat diffraction-limit, and unlike conventional NSOM, the size of the aperture does not determine the resolution.

articleTitle: Carrier Concentration and Junction Temperature Dependencies of Illumination Efficiency of GaN Power Light-Emitting Diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulsed drive currents have helped us separate the effects that junction temperature and carrier concentration have on current-induced efficiency degradation of GaN Power LEDs. Carrier concentration and junction temperature dependencies of illumination efficiency are presented.

articleTitle: Time domain terahertz non destructive evaluation of water intrusion in composites and corrosion under insulation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time domain terahertz (a.k.a. T-Ray or THz) imaging is used to detect water intrusion and delamination in composite structures used in radomes. Corrosion is detected on pipes beneath opaque insulation.

articleTitle: Observation of heavy photon state in ultrahigh-Q photonic crystal coupled resonator chain
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrahigh-Q (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) resonant modes of 10 sequentially coupled photonic crystal resonators are successfully demonstrated. Evaluated dispersion curves reveal a very small coupling factor (k~0.0003), which corresponds to a very slow light mode.

articleTitle: Negative refraction in mid-infrared semiconductor metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Semiconductor metamaterials consisting of n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaInAs/i-AlInAs heterostructures that support negative index modes in the mid-infrared are reported. We demonstrate negative refraction in these metamaterials for wavelengths from 9-15 μm over a wide range of incidence angles.

articleTitle: High-dynamic-range, 200-ps window, single-shot cross-correlator for ultrahigh intensity laser characterization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel high-dynamic-range cross-correlator is presented that enables single-shot characterization of pulse contrast for ultrahigh intensity lasers in the temporal region up to 200 ps.

articleTitle: PMD compensation with coherent reception and digital signal processing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent reception in optical communication systems enables PMD compensation by digital signal processing. An approach for broadband compensation is presented and the required oversampling ratio and resolution of the analog-digital conversion is examined.

articleTitle: Pulse characterization using Hilbert transformation temporal interferometry (HTTI)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a simple ultra-short optical pulse reconstruction method based on Hilbert transform temporal interferometry. The complex profile of a weak picosecond pulse after dispersion by a 100-m SMF is accurately reconstructed using this technique.

articleTitle: Long fiber-optic perimeter sensor: Signature analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A phase-sensitive OTDR provides a cost-effective and highly sensitive solution for monitoring of long perimeters. Signature analysis of the ϕ-OTDR signal allows the identification of intruders on foot as well as vehicles.

articleTitle: NOEMS devices based on slot-waveguides
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present device applications for Nano-Opto-Electro-Mechanical System (NOEMS) structures based on the evanescent-wave bonding acting on silicon slot-waveguides. Useful alloptical or electrooptical functionalities include: phase modulation, polarization mode dispersion, near-field probing and reconfigurable optical delay.

articleTitle: All-optical ASK-DPSK signal regeneration using a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 10-Gb/s and 20-Gb/s DPSK and ASK-DPSK signal regeneration based on cross-phase modulation in a SOA. The amplitude noise is reduced and the receiver sensitivity is improved by 3 dB.

articleTitle: Semiclassical theory of the Hyperlens
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study ray dynamics inside the Hyperlens, a device recently demonstrated as capable of sub-diffraction-limited far-field imaging. The obtained semiclassical result of spiraling rays is confirmed by numerical simulations of gaussian beam scattering from the hyperlens.

articleTitle: One centimeter spatial resolution temperature measurements from 25 to 850 °C using rayleigh scatter in gold coated fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the use of swept wavelength interferometry for distributed fiber-optic, temperature measurements of up to 850 °C over a lm fiber segment in commercially available, single mode, gold coated fiber. The interrogation technique is based on measuring the spectral shift of the intrinsic Rayleigh backscatter signal along the optical fiber and converting the spectral shift to temperature.

articleTitle: Conical diffraction and gap solitons in honeycomb photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict and present the first observation of conical diffraction arising from k-space singularities in the band-structure of a periodic potential. The experiments are carried out in honeycomb lattices, where we also generate "honeycomb gap-solitons".

articleTitle: Wideband SBS slow light in a single mode fiber using a phase-modulated pump
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a 10-Gb/s PRBS phase-modulated pump, we achieve SBS slow light of 10-GHz, 26.6-ps pulses by 10.6 ps. The correlation between the pulse width and the amount of phase modulation is reported.

articleTitle: Optical "Hyperlens": imaging in the far field beyond the diffraction limit
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a system for far field optical imaging below the diffraction limit. As opposed to the "superlens" based on negative index materials, our approach allows image magnification and is robust with respect to material losses.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of coherent linear photonic crystal VCSEL arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Formalism from Young's two-pinhole experiment is used to study the lasing modes of coupled 2×1 photonic crystal vertical cavity laser arrays. The eigenmodes of the system as well as the coherence change with injection current.

articleTitle: Development of planar waveguide based integrated optic SPR (Surface Plasmon Resonance) sensor array
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An integrated optic SPR biosensor array with on-substrate integrated photodetectors has been developed. The device is able to generate SPR electrical signal directly and has the potential for high throughput optical sensing.

articleTitle: Metal-encased semiconductor nanowires as waveguides for ultrasmall lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a semiconductor nanowire encased by a metal offers the smallest laser waveguide, despite the large Joule loss. The TM01 mode immediately above its cut-off is most advantageous for making sub-wavelength lasers.

articleTitle: Fundamental causality and a criterion of negative refraction with low optical losses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: From the fundamental requirement of causality, we derive a rigorous criterion of negative refraction (left-handedness). This criterion imposes the lower limits on the electric and magnetic losses in the region of the negative refraction. If these losses are eliminated or significantly reduced by any means, including the compensation by active (gain) media, then the negative refraction will disappear. This theory can be particularly useful in testing the feasibility of the left-handed materials design.

articleTitle: Exact dynamic localization in curved AlGaAs optical waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first experimental observations of exact dynamic localization of an optical beam in periodically-curved strongly-coupled waveguide arrays. Spatial and spectral measurements of two and four period devices agree well with theory.

articleTitle: Thermo-optical and -mechanical parameters of Nd:GdVO4 and Nd:YVO4
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured thermal conductivity, thermal expansion coefficient, and thermal refractive index coefficient of Nd:GdVO4 and Nd:YVO4. Superiority comparisons of laser media under high power laser operations were also discussed from the viewpoints of thermal characteristics.

articleTitle: CdTe quantum dot in tunable hydrogel nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical emission from CdTe quantum dots (QDs) embedded in poly-N-isopropylacrylamide hydrogel nanocrystallites can be enhanced over 100% using thermal and electrical stimulus. Relative distance amongst QDs was modified tuning the hydrogel facilitating resonant energy transfer.

articleTitle: Optimal pulse compression via sequential filamentation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally a robust method based on sequential filamentation to optimize compression of high-energy pulses in gases. We gain insight into this process by comparing compression dynamics for linear- and circularly-polarized pulses.

articleTitle: Rapidly tunable, narrow linewidth, 1W, 1 kHz Ce:LiCAF laser pumped by the fourth harmonic of a diode-pumped Nd:YLF laser for ozone DIAL measurements
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact, rapidly tunable (282-315 nm), narrow line-width (0.2 nm) Ce:LiCAF laser pumped by the fourth harmonic of a diode-pumped Nd:YLF laser is capable of delivering 1mJ/pulse at a pulse repetition frequency of 1 kHz.

articleTitle: Coherent single-photon generation and trapping with practical cavity QED systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how to coherently trap or generate a single photon in a practical cavity QED system that could operate well within the weak-coupling regime, and in the presence of realistic imperfections.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinear optical susceptibilities of surface and bulk of glass
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We determine all the components of the surface susceptibility tensor and the separable part of the bulk tensor for optical second-harmonic generation in centrosymmetric and isotropic glass and calibrate the results against quartz crystal.

articleTitle: Suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering in a photonic/phononic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Analytical model has been developed, which predicts significant suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering in a fiber structure, which provides photonic-bandgap guidance for optical waves and, simultaneously, phononic-bandgap suppression of electrostrictively driven acoustic waves.

articleTitle: Multi-Watt Supercontinuum Generation from 0.3 to 2.4 μm in PCF Tapers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Supercontinua spanning 320-2400nm have been generated in long photonic-crystal-fiber tapers. Total average powers of over 3.5W and spectral-power-densities in the blue of over 5mW/nm are demonstrated. Use as a broadly-tunable pulse source is proposed.

articleTitle: 100 mJ Q-switched, high efficiency, high brightness Nd:YAG oscillator: Wavefront analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A diode-pumped, 100 mJ/pulse, Nd:YAG oscillator employing a dual pump head design aligned orthogonally in an unstable resonator configuration producing aperture-free TEM00 beams is presented.

articleTitle: Nonlocal effects in effective medium response of nanolayered metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the majority pf plasmonic nanolayered composites, despite being subwanelength, are not described by effective medium theory and develop an adequate description of electromagnetism in these systems.

articleTitle: Controlling the excited state charge transfer in DMABN using shaped femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The ability of multiphoton intrapulse interference (MII) to regulate the formation of the twisted charge transfer state in DMABN upon three-photon excitation is explored and monitored via fluorescence.

articleTitle: Techniques based on digital multiplexing holography for three-dimensional object tracking
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three techniques based on digital multiplexing holography for tracking objects in threedimensional space are presented. Multiple holograms were combined into a single camera frame with high spatio-temporal resolution. Practical limitations and experiments are shown.

articleTitle: 160-Gbit/s optical time-division demultiplexing based on cross-phase modulation in a 2-m-long dispersion-shifted Bi2O3 photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical time-division demultiplexing of 160-Gbit/s optical signals is demonstrated by using a 2-m-long dispersion-shifted Bi2O3-based photonic crystal fiber. Power penalties are less than 6 dB for all 10-Gbit/s tributaries.

articleTitle: Transient thermal properties of high-power diode laser bars
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The transient thermal properties of high-power diode laser bars with active and passive cooling are analyzed experimentally with thermal imaging and through their thermal wavelength tuning behavior and modeled with the finite element method.

articleTitle: Nanowire coupling to photonic crystal nanocavities for single photon sources
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient evanescent coupling via a silica loop-nanowire, to ultra-small quantum-dot photonic-crystal cavities. It enables the tuning of both the Q-factor and the wavelength of the cavity mode independently.

articleTitle: Coupled metallic antenna nanorod arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate coupling effects in arrays of gold nanorods, studying both strongly and weakly coupled regimes, with the ultimate goal of incorporating these arrays onto a compact fiber device.

articleTitle: Ti:sapphire-pumped infrared femtosecond optical parametric oscillator based on BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A femtosecond optical parametric oscillator based on the nonlinear material BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> pumped by a Kerr-lens-mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser is reported. Continuous tuning across the spectral range of 1.2-1.6 μm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Collapse and stability of necklace beams in Kerr media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate necklace beams in Kerr media. For powers greater than one critical power for self-focusing per bead, we observe a transition from collective behavior to independent collapse of each of the beads.

articleTitle: Single-photonics at telecom wavelengths using nanowire superconducting single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel single-photon detectors based on NbN superconducting nanostructures promise orders-of-magnitude improvement over InGaAs APDs. We demonstrate this improved performance for the first time by measuring the g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(τ) on single photon states produced by a quantum dot at telecom wavelength.

articleTitle: Generation of entangled photon pairs based on intra-cavity four-wave-mixing in dual-wavelength fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated a compact and efficient source of entangled photon pairs by using intra-cavity four wave mixing (FWM) in dual-wavelength Erbium doped fiber ring laser for the application in quantum key distribution systems.

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier dynamics in semiconductor nanowires
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-resolved measurements of carrier dynamics in Ge and GaN nanowires reveal that carrier relaxation in these systems is governed by surface states and defects. This has significant implications for nanowire-based devices in photonics and thermoelectrics.

articleTitle: ILE 25PW single laser beamline: The French step for the European Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the design of a single ultra intense laser beamline delivering 25PW pulses at one shot per minute as a first step of an Ultra Intense High Field Science European project (Extreme Light Infrastructure).

articleTitle: Wavefront correction and aberrations pre-compensation in the middle of petawatt-class CPA laser chains
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe preliminary experiences to validate correction of wavefront aberrations in middle of laser chain. This technique allows correction of aberrations from first part, and the pre-compensation of aberrations built in second part of laser.

articleTitle: Powerful high repetition rate nanosecond optical parametric generator in MgO:PPLN tunable from 3.5 μm to 4.6 μm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a nanosecond MgO:PPLN OPG tunable in the MIR from 3.5 to 4.6 μm with an average output power of 600 mW at 3.8 μm and more than 100 mW at 4.6 μm.

articleTitle: Coulomb-enhanced shift currents from symmetry reduction in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new shift current tensor element resulting from symmetry reduction in semiconductor quantum wells, The shift current is strongly enhanced by Coulomb interaction and shows a pronounced maximum at the light-hole exciton resonance.

articleTitle: A 142-W diffraction-limited Q-switched rotary disk Yb- YAG laser for material processing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The average power of a diffraction-limited Q-switched diode pumped solid state laser was scaled to 142 W. At 100 W, the laser drilled 44 μm diameter holes in 3-mm thick stainless steel in 3.4 s.

articleTitle: Spectral broadening in ultra-long raman fibre lasers by Optical wave turbulence
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intra-cavity spectra of ultra-long (up to 84 km cavity length) Raman lasers have been measured and simulated. The results demonstrate FWM-induced turbulent-like (involving up to 108 modes) broadening of the spectrum with clear exponential tails.

articleTitle: A compact annular beam generator based on a laser diode pumped power build-up cavity for optical tweezers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a novel, very simple mode selective annular beam generator with a laser diode pumped power build-up cavity and cylindrical lens based mode converter. The system can readily be available for optical tweezers.

articleTitle: Optical coherent manipulation of a spin wave in tm:YAG
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nuclear spin states are optically characterized in thulium-doped YAG. Thulium is considered as a substitute to praseodymium and europium in the prospect of quantum light storage in solids.

articleTitle: Synchronization, chaos and consistency
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Identical synchronization of the chaotic fluctuations of nonlinear optical systems leads to schemes for communication. Extensions to new phenomena including generalized synchronization and mutually coupled system dynamics will be described.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of non-gaussian attacks on a continuous-variable quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An intercept-resend attack on a continuous-variable quantum key distribution protocol is investigated experimentally. The users and eavesdropper available information rates are consistent with the optimality of Gaussian attacks resulting from the security proofs.

articleTitle: Nonlinear switching in a Bragg grating with periodic ξ(3)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate numerically the nonlinear switching in a Bragg grating with a periodically modulated nonlinearity. Improved functionalities can be obtained through a π phase-shift between the linear and nonlinear gratings.

articleTitle: Reflected pump technique for saturated absorption spectroscopy inside photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Saturated absorption spectroscopy in acetylene-filled photonic bandgap fibers is investigated. A new simplified technique for saturated absorption spectroscopy is described, where pressure and power parameters have been optimized for use as a frequency reference.

articleTitle: Cooling of a micro-mechanical oscillator using radiation-pressure induced dynamical backaction
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how dynamical backaction of radiation pressure can be exploited for passive laser-cooling of high-frequency (>50 MHz) mechanical oscillation modes of ultra-high-finesse optical microcavities from room temperature to 11 K.

articleTitle: Rotationally-resolved depletion spectroscopy of ultracold KRb molecules
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use photoassociation of ultracold atoms to produce ultracold KRb molecules in high vibrational levels of the ground state. Depletion spectroscopy is employed to detect these molecules with both vibrational and rotational resolution.

articleTitle: Investigation of spin-induced pauli blocking on electron dynamics in n-doped In0.4Ga0.6As/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A nanosecond-scale recovery component is observed in time-resolved differential transmission spectroscopy experiments on the electron relaxation in n-doped quantum dots. Polarization-dependent measurements show the recovery is not due to Pauli blocking driven by spin relaxation.

articleTitle: Fiber-free characterization of photonic integrated circuits by thermoreflectance microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of amplified spontaneous emission in thermoreflectance imaging of photonic integrated circuits for fiber-free characterization of the integrated cascaded semiconductor optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Self-steepening without self-phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A first optical manifestation of the Chen-Lee-Liu-type derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation results in self-steepening of ultrashort pulses and shock formation without simultaneous self-phase modulation and spectral broadening. Experiments verify theory.

articleTitle: Laser processing in printform fabrication
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser engraving is the fastest and most versatile process for gravure cylinder fabrication. New experiments with high power fiber lasers (cw lasers and pulsed MOPA systems) resulted in improved cell precision, screen resolution and efficiency.

articleTitle: Development of a sodium laser guide star for astronomical adaptive optics systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a new laser design for a 50 W laser guide star source, suitable for large aperture telescopes employing multi conjugate adaptive optics systems. Design verification experiments will be presented showing bandwidth control and progress towards power scaling.

articleTitle: Mitigation of transient response of erbium-doped fiber amplifier for burst traffic of high speed optical packets
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We found that an EDFA which adopted the EDF with enhanced active erbium area can mitigate short-term transient response for sub-micro seconds caused by the traffic of high speed optical packets without any external controlling.

articleTitle: Spectral and spatial mode control in self-seeded semiconductor disk laser using optical feedback from fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Semiconductor disk laser with mode control using the feedback from a partially reflecting fiber Bragg grating. With seed signal, the wavelength is locked to the Bragg wavelength and beam quality factor M2decreases from 1.6 to below 1.05.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of a negative-index photonic metamaterial with three functional layers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of negative-index photonic metamaterials with up to three functional layers. The effective material properties of the photonic metamaterials do not change significantly with the number of functional layers.

articleTitle: Mid-IR luminescence of nanocrystalline II-VI semiconductors doped with transition metal ions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method of transition metal (TM) (Cr, Co and Fe) doped II-VI nanocrystalline quantum dots (NCD) fabrication based on laser ablation was demonstrated. For the first time mid-IR luminescence from TM:II-VI NCD is reported.

articleTitle: Optimal Cd molar fraction in Zn1-xCdxTe terahertz emitters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The influence of Cd molar fraction on the terahertz generation from Zn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Cd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x<sub>Te has been studied. The optimal Cd compositions have been obtained as x=0.10 at λ=820nm and x=0.65 at λ=850nm.</sub></sub>

articleTitle: Uncompensated 20 Gb/s duobinary polarization division multiplexing transmission over 200 km
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transmission of 20 Gb/s optical signal over 200 km of uncompensated SMF fiber is achieved. The duobinary format dispersion robustness has been exploited together with polarization division multiplexing to significantly increase the maximum uncompensated reach.

articleTitle: Electron tunnelling limited coherence time of single quantum dot photodiode based qubit
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate technique to time-resolve the population inversion of a quantum dot exciton, and measure T1. Combined with measurements of the coherence time T2. T2 is limited by electron tunnelling from the dot.

articleTitle: Nanostructured optics and optoelectronics for dense optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum well structures in germanium and nanophotonic structures in dielectrics and metals promise future optics, optoelectronics and electronics, all possibly combined in one silicon compatible platform. Challenges, approaches and recent progress are summarized.

articleTitle: Nonlinear scattering and trapping by local photonic potentials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally study nonlinear scattering by local photonic potentials embedded in continuous Kerr media, and demonstrate nonlinear trapping in guiding potentials and resonant transmission in anti-guiding potentials. The results are verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of ultrafast laser ablation efficiency of crystalline silicon
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast laser ablation of crystalline silicon was investigated as a function of temperature. The ablation efficiency is slightly enhanced with an apparent decrease in ablation threshold and surface roughness at a high substrate temperature.

articleTitle: Shape analysis of laser deformed metallic nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-intensity fs-laser pulses permanently change the form of silver nanoparticles in glass and result in optical dichroism. Optical and small angle x-ray scattering experiments are shown which clarify the 3-dimensional shape of the resulting particles.

articleTitle: Ultra cold bosons in incommensurate optical lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the quantum phase diagram of ultra cold bosons in 1D incommensurate optical lattices, as compared to commensurate lattices. We also examine the experimental implications of incommesurability and one spatial dimension.

articleTitle: Optical whispering gallery mode resonators with Q > 1011 and F > 107
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a proper thermal annealing leads to a significant increase of the quality factors of crystalline whispering gallery mode (WGM) resonators. We have demonstrated a fluoride resonator with Q exceeding 1011 using the method.

articleTitle: EDFA gain stabilization with fast transient behavior by use of a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a solution to improve gain-clamped EDFA stabilization time by inserting in the conventional laser loop configuration an extra SOA. Experimental results demonstrate stabilization time as short as 0.2μs in a purposely-considered critical situation.

articleTitle: Fourier domain common-path fiber OCT with tunable reference: analysis and optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have built a Fourier domain, fiber-optic, common-path OCT system with a tunable reference. We report our initial investigation of the performance of the system and analyze the results.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution with high-speed superconducting single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore the potential of high-speed nanowire superconducting single-photon detectors for quantum key distribution in fiber, over long distances (at 1550 nm) and at high bit rates (at 850 nm).

articleTitle: Femtosecond dynamics of the laser-induced solid-to-liquid phase transition in aluminum
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present femtosecond time-resolved broadband measurements of the reflectivity of aluminum during the laser-induced solid-to-liquid phase transition. Our experiments show that this transition is a thermal process, settling an existing controversy.

articleTitle: Coupling of nano-stripe and nano-slot plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coupling effects between two types of surface-plasmon-polariton waveguides in the subwavelength regime (stripes and slots) are measured experimentally at λ = 1.55μm using near field microscopy and validated by finite element modal calculations.

articleTitle: Fast light using multiple cascaded quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate variable fast light at room temperature using multiple cascaded quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifiers. Controllable delay is achieved both electrically and optically, or by varying the number of amplifiers or amplifier-to-amplifier attenuation.

articleTitle: Dispersion and loss limitation on the performance of optical delay lines based on coupled resonant structures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Relative importance of group velocity dispersion and loss in limiting performance of optical delay lines based on coupled resonator structures is investigated. Both factors play roughly comparable role for the bit rates of 2.5-40GBs

articleTitle: 30W CW operation of single-chip laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report CW operation of 30W from single chip laser diodes at 808 nm, with an estimated lifetime of over 40,000 hours. They are designed with broad waveguides using InAlGaAs/AlGaAs/GaAs material system grown by MOCVD.

articleTitle: Highly accurate material parameter extraction from THz time domain spectroscopy data
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel optical parameter extraction algorithm for THz time domain spectroscopy signal processing. To demonstrate the potential of our algorithm we investigate thin low index samples and samples with sharp absorption features.

articleTitle: Optical isolators based on surface magneto plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Strong nonreciprocal phase shift is attainable when plasmon polariton propagates on the interface between metal and magneto-optical material in presence of transverse magnetic field. This effect is a basis for short low loss nanoplasmonic isolators.

articleTitle: One-way continuous-variable quantum key distribution over 5km of standard telecom fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of one-way Gaussian-modulated coherent state quantum key distribution system over kilometers of standard telecom fiber. Under realistic assumptions, the achievable secrete key rate is over 10kb/s.

articleTitle: Asymmetric explosion of laser-irradiated hydrogen clusters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
