abstract: Under conditions of small hydrogen cluster size, where we expected angular-dependent time-of-flight (TOF) proton spectra consistent with isotropic coulomb explosions, we instead found strong explosion asymmetry with fast protons emitted preferentially in the direction of the laser polarization.

articleTitle: Multipartite atom(s)-field entanglement in cavity QED
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider the entanglement between a multi-level atom and two cavity modes for a cavity QED system, find that cross-correlations between the two modes are witness to atom-field entanglement. Concurrences and log negativities are also calculated.

articleTitle: Diffraction and trapping of light at the interface between two discrete media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied numerically and experimentally the linear diffraction and trapping of light at the hetero-interface between two different 1D AlGaAs waveguide arrays. A new "breather" state guided by the interface was observed.

articleTitle: Polymer waveguide with 4-channel circular GI cores toward high-speed optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate polymer waveguides with 4-channel circular graded-index cores for the first time by the preform method. The new waveguide exhibits very low-loss (0.029dB/cm), high bandwidth (estimated 60Gbps for lm) and low inter-channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: Highly efficient two-photon absorption cross-sections and their frequency dependence in small organic molecules
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the frequency dependence of the high two-photon absorption (TPA) crosssections (σTPA) measured in small organic molecules. The best molecule has a σTPA= 9 ± 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-48</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>s/photon, up to 10 times that of AF-50.

articleTitle: Broadband THz time-domain spectroscopy of single-wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Complex dielectric function ε(&3x003C9;) of single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWNTs) is determined by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy from 0.2 to 20 THz. Reε(ω) exhibits extremely large and positive value at low frequency, indicating the response of small gap SWNTs.

articleTitle: Single-shot time resolved measurement of molecular alignment in laser-irradiated gases
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present single-shot direct measurements of nonlinear refractive index temporal dynamics as effective way to determine instantaneous and non-instantaneous Raman contribution to n2 in molecular gases in the presence of high-intensity femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Quadratic solitons in 2D nonlinear photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first observation of spatial solitons in a 2D nonlinear photonic crystal. The experiments were performed in an hexagonally poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide designed for second harmonic generation from ~1.55 μm.

articleTitle: Teleporting below the vacuum-noise level: Non-local transfer of squeezing and entanglement
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the unconditional quantum teleportation of a squeezed state of light. We observe -0.8± 0.2dB of squeezing in the teleported state. Our experiment also demonstrates the first unconditional quantum teleportation of entanglement.

articleTitle: On-axis excitation of two-dimensional gap solitons and gap soliton trains
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate two-dimensional gap solitons/soliton-trains by single-beam on-axis excitation in a self-defocusing "backbone" photonic lattice. Interferograms and k-space spectra indicate staggered structure of the gap solitons arising from M-symmetry points of the first Bloch band.

articleTitle: Technique for photon statistics reconstruction by using on/off detectors.
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Report on first experimental applications of a measurement scheme with variable quantum efficiency single-photon ON/OFF detectors for evaluating the diagonal elements of the density matrix for various quantum optical states, without involving photon counting.

articleTitle: Narrow-line, high-repetition-rate THz-wave generation from collinearly phase-matched difference-frequency mixing in periodically poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report difference frequency generation of THz waves from collinearly phase-matched, periodically poled lithium niobate crystals. Transform-limited THz-wave pulses with a wavelength range between 190~210 μm were generated at a kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Geometric optics for surface plasmon integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use an analytic geometric optics method to solve for the cut-off, propagation and dispersion of surface plasmon stripe waveguides. Comprehensive computations are used to validate the method, which may be applied to other devices.

articleTitle: Multi-uplink passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose to use multiple uplinks in passive optical networks (PONs) to increase the optical transmission power from users to central office. The requirement of the PON receiver at the central office is discussed.

articleTitle: Two-wave mixing in a broad-area semiconductor amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The two-wave mixing in the broad-area semiconductor amplifier was investigated, both theoretically and experimentally. The experimental results obtained in an 810 nm, 200 μm wide GaAlAs amplifier show good agreement with the theory.

articleTitle: Nonlinear resonance broadening and shift due to thermo-optical instability in microsphere resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broadening of the resonance coupling peaks and their shifting have been observed in the tests of light coupling into the high-Q microspherical resonators. The both effects have been explained by thermo-optical nonlinearity causing resonance instability.

articleTitle: Uniform growth of 10-μm-core double-clad Cr4+:YAG crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An auxiliary sapphire tube serving as a heat capacitor was used in the co-drawing laser-heated pedestal growth system for fabricating small core crystal fibers. A factor of 3 improvement was achieved. Uniform 10-μm-core double-clad Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal fibers were successfully fabricated as a result.

articleTitle: Analysis of ring-metal-aperture VCSELs for single- lateral-mode operation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The role of metal apertures in lateral-mode confinement in VCSELs is clarified by a detailed effective-frequency-method analysis of an oxide-confined VCSEL structure. The conditions for suppression of higher-order lateral modes using metal apertures are established.

articleTitle: Nano-optics for chemical and materials characterization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a hybrid microscope which combines structured-illumination techniques with Raman-spectroscopy to record 100 nm resolution images with chemically-specific contrast. We will show images of semiconductor nanostructures and discuss the technique's advantages and requirements.

articleTitle: High harmonic imaging of conical intersections
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new ultrafast method for observing molecular wave packets in conical intersections (CI), based on high harmonic generation (HHG). Electronic symmetry change and nuclear dynamics can be observed in the HHG spectra.

articleTitle: Carrier capture and recombination in 2.4μm GaSb-based type-I quantum well high power diode lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Carrier lifetime of 2ns was measured in GaSb-based type-I quantum-well high power laser heterostructures at threshold carrier concentration. Increased carrier capture rate was observed in laser heterostructures with reduced waveguide thickness.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon cavities for solid-state cavity quantum electrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a cavity based on surface plasmon modes confined by metallic distributed Bragg reflectors and analyze the interaction of the cavity mode with quantum dots (QD). The system exhibits strong Purcell enhancement.

articleTitle: Strong relative intensity squeezing by 4-wave mixing in Rb vapor
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured -6.3 dB of relative intensity squeezing at 795 nm, generated by stimulated, nondegenerate four-wave mixing in a hot rubidium vapor. This scheme is of interest for experiments involving cold atoms or atomic ensembles.

articleTitle: DAVLL with absolute frequency reference
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a simple addition to the standard DAVLL that combines the large frequency capture range of the DAVLL and the precision structure information available from standard saturated absorption. Experimental measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Optical comb filter based on the spectral talbot effect in uniform fiber bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We numerically and experimentally demonstrate a comb filter based on the analogy between the compression of phase modulated pulse trains and grating spectrum formation. Unchirped uniform fiber Bragg gratings are sufficient for implementing this filter.

articleTitle: Analysis of the spontaneous emission rate enhancement by surface plasmons in a thin metallic layer embedded in semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the modification of spontaneous emission rates from multi-quantum wells beneath a thin metallic layer embedded in semiconductor.

Index Terms: Enhancement Of The Spontaneous Emission Rate

articleTitle: New collapsing solutions of the time-dispersive nonlinear Schrödinger equation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that super-Gaussian pulses with anomalous dispersion collapse with a three-dimensional shell-type profile. These pulses undergo pulse splitting in space and time, and subsequently break into collapsing 3-D wavepackets.

articleTitle: Pulse shaping using binary sequences designed with error diffusion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Continuous optical and electrical pulse shaping is obtained by spectral filtering of binary discrete sequences of pulses designed with the deterministic error-diffusion algorithm. Experimental demonstration to RF pulse shaping is presented.

articleTitle: Anomalous-refraction-induced strong resonances and enhancement of absorption in thin-film photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate strong resonances and absorption enhancement in thin-film photonic crystals due to distinguished anomalous refraction (parallel interface refraction), where off-normal incident beams are refracted to directions nearly parallel to the surfaces of thin film.

articleTitle: High-resolution swept-source optical coherence tomography with the frequency-sweeping the broadened spectrum of a fs Cr:forsterite laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a spectral-domain optical coherence tomography system, including a broadband frequency sweeping light source with the central wavelength around 1250 nm, to achieve an axial resolution of 2.4 μm in tissue.

articleTitle: Electron spin beat nonlinear susceptibility in semiconductor quant um wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a comprehensive theory of optically probing electron spin precession in low-density quantum well exciton populations. We trace the microscopic origins of features observed in differential transmission and Faraday rotation measurements to exciton interactions.

articleTitle: Nano-spheres dispersed nematic liquid crystals for broadband tunable negative-zero-positive index materials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is demonstrated that by introducing gain and nano-spheres in aligned nematic liquid crystals, one can design metamaterials which possess broadband tunable negative-zero-positive index with relatively low loss compared to other material systems.

articleTitle: Plasmonic quantum cascade laser antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the plasmonic quantum cascade laser antenna, that can confine mid-infrared radiation beyond the diffraction limit, by integrating gold optical antennas on the laser facet.

articleTitle: Ultrafast observation of the coexistence of antiferromagnetism and superconductivity in a High-Tc superconductor
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast quasiparticle dynamics of the high-Tc superconductor Tl2Ba2Ca2CU3Oy were probed using the all-optical pump-probe technique. Our results are consistent with the coexistence of antiferromagnetism and superconductivity at low temperatures, resulting in the depression of the superconducting gap and the opening of a spin-density-wave gap.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional photonic crystals fabricated by double-angled plasma etching
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-dimensional photonic crystals with a depth of two lattice constants are successfully fabricated by a two-stage angled plasma etching method. The sample showed ~90% reflectance and ~10dB attenuation around the photonic bandgap wavelength region.

articleTitle: Efficient CW optical limiting in a nematic liquid crystal twist cell
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Highly efficient optical limiting is observed in a nematic liquid crystal twist cell constructed with photoconducting alignment surfaces. Limiting at the submilliwatt level is obtained. The effective optical Kerr coefficient is approximately 10cm2/W.

articleTitle: Bistability and cavity solitons in semiconductor resonator with exciton-polariton nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical bistability and observation of bright and dark spatial resonator solitons are reported for a semiconductor microresonator in which the nonlinearity stems from exciton polaritons.

articleTitle: A chaotic optical cavity combined with a quantum cascade laser for chemical vapor sensing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel multi-pass optical cavity with partially-chaotic ray dynamics has been combined with a Quantum Cascade laser for sensing of ethanol. The 4-cm diameter cavity shows an optical path length in the mid-infrared of ~4.5-m.

articleTitle: Practical method for calculating the interferometric autocorrelation trace of an attosecond pulse train
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how to calculate the interferomtric autocorrelation trace of the attosecond pulse train (APT). Nonlinear interference fringes on the spatial profile of the spatially divided two replicas of the APT is essential.

articleTitle: Aggressive commercialization in a sub-critical market
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optics, photonics, and lasers are key components of Florida's tech-based economy. This talk discusses the University of Central Florida's focused education, research, commercialization, and industry partnership programs to support and grow this economic sector.

articleTitle: Minimum energy pulses for quantum logic cannot be shared
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that if an electromagnetic pulse with average photon number n is used to carry out the same quantum logical operation on a set of N atoms, the worst-case overall error probability scales as N2/n .

articleTitle: Microbend gratings fabricated in glass substrates via direct writing with near-infrared femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microbend gratings were fabricated inside bulk glass via direct writing with femtosecond pulses from a multi-pass-cavity Ti:S laser. Critical periods, with maximum transmission loss, existed and shifted with waveguide refractive index, like fiber microbend gratings.

articleTitle: 30-fs ultra sensitive absorption spectroscopy of low vapor pressure molecules: proton transfer in the gas phas
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our transient absorption spectrometer for gas phase and solution samples can resolve changes of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> in optical density. This allows the first direct comparison of ultrafast proton transfer at low vapor pressure and in solution.

articleTitle: A view from a leading chinese laser system manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: General description of the industrial laser processing market in China, prospect and developing trend of the china industrial laser processing market, introduction of Chutian Laser group and its products.

articleTitle: Ellipsometrically probed plasmonic resonances in a square array of Au nanocubes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance (LSPR) of metallic nanoparticles has been widely studied for sensing applications. We propose an ellipsometry-based configuration for sensing exploiting the polarization dependent LSPR excited on anisotropic and uniformly oriented Au nanostructures.

articleTitle: Silicon electro-optic switching based on coupled-microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyze silicon coupled-microring resonators-based electro-optic switching using injection-type p-i-n diodes. Numerical simulations and modeling suggest electronic-logic lightwave switching by applying two electrical data streams. We observe non-reciprocity between states (0, 1) and (1, 0).

articleTitle: Impact of facet reflectivity and operation condition on injection-locking fabry-perot laser diodes with spectrum sliced ASE noise in WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the performance of Fabry-Perot laser diodes (FPLDs) injection locked by spectrum sliced ASE noise for WDM-PON. Results show that the performance of the injection locked FPLDs is significantly improved by optimizing their front-facet reflectivity, operation temperature and bias current.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of stimulated brillouin scattering to submerged objects detecting
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear Optical Properties of Stimulated Brillouin scattering to submerged objects detecting are analyzed. With the characteristics of threshold, SBS only occurs when the incident laser is focused in the focusing regime. When there is an object present in front of the focus leading to lower incident intensity then SBS don't occur. The backward SBS signal depends on the location of the submerged object. With the object come near to focusing regime, the backward Stokes signal rise up from zero to a Maximum, and then grow to saturation. The delay time of echo signal to pump signal can give the location of submerged object. Relationships of reflected energy dependent on location of object in SBS cell is analyzed both theretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Coupled-mode theory analysis of optical bistability involving Fano resonances in high-Q/Vm silicon photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study optical bistability associated with Fano resonances in high-Q/V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> silicon photonic crystal nanocavities through the nonlinear coupled-mode theory framework. The χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> effects, free-carrier dynamics, thermal effects, and linear losses are included and investigated numerically.

articleTitle: Simultaneous generation of two pairs of entangled photons in periodically poled lithium niobate crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose that two pairs of entangled photons will be generated simultaneously through spontaneous parametric down-conversion pumped by a monochromatic light only in periodically poled lithium niobate crystals without more complex crystal structures.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon cavity ring down
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally explore the dynamics of surface plasmons propagating along a smooth gold film as they bounce between two sub-wavelength slits. We observe ring-down features reminiscent of an optical beam in a Fabry-Perot resonator.

articleTitle: Preparation and measurement of few-atom number states with a double-well atom interferometer
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a double-well optical lattice as an atom interferometer to load and measure atomic number-squeezed states with N = 1 or 2 and Poissonian states with ⟨N⟩ ≈1 into the lattice ground state.

articleTitle: Photon coupling mechanism in 1.3-μm quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A room-temperature negative characteristic temperature is demonstrated for a p-type modulation doped 1.3-μm quantum dot laser. A photon coupling mechanism is purposed to explain the temperature-dependent J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> for both p-doped and un-doped QD lasers.

articleTitle: Acoustic phonon damping of Rabi oscillations in In(Ga)As quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Excitonic ground state Rabi oscillations in In(Ga)As quantum dots are studied via an ultrafast spectral hole burning technique. From comparison with frequency domain data we find that acoustic phonon-induced dephasing processes damp the oscillations.

articleTitle: Creation of dicke states in distant qubits using linear optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a method to generate long-lived symmetric Dicke states of distant particles requiring linear optics only. Thereby we grant access to genuine entanglement of any number of qubits via measurement using multifold detection techniques.

articleTitle: Chirality dependence of absorption in carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an analytical approach to the optical absorption in arbitrary carbon nanotubes. We show the chirality dependence of the absorption coefficient to be the result from both the JDOS and the optical matrix element.

articleTitle: Bandwidth tunable band rejection filter based on helicoidal fiber grating pair of opposite hellicity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new type of all-fiber bandwidth tunable rejection filter using cascaded helicoidal long-period fiber gratings in single-mode optical fiber and report controllable broadband rejection characteristic with low insertion loss and polarization dependent loss.

articleTitle: Lithography, plasmonics and sub-wavelength aperture exposure technology
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report enhanced transmission of 250 nm radiation by sub-wavelength square aperture arrays on silver and demonstrate its use in optical lithography with far-reduced number of addressed pixels to produce very good edge acuity.

articleTitle: Dispersion tuning of chirped sampled fiber bragg gratings by controlling only duty ratios
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the in-channel dispersion of the chirped sampled fiber Bragg gratings can be tuned by controlling the duty ratio, thus various in-channel dispersion values can be realized using a single chirped phase mask.

articleTitle: Dynamic coupling-decoupling crossover in the current-driven vortex State in T12Ba2CaCu2O8 probed by the Josephson plasma resonance
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Employing terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we have measured the Josephson plasma resonance in Tl2Ba2CaCu2O8 high-Tc thin films, and studied the current-driven coupling-decoupling crossover in the driven vortex lattice.

articleTitle: Acoustic phonon dynamics in exciton self-trapping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We probe the vibrational dynamics associated with the formation of self-trapped excitons at low temperature. The early-time oscillatory response provides evidence for acoustic phonon dynamics as an integral part of the localization process.

articleTitle: Enhancement of fluorescence and raman scattering in a liquid-core optical fiber based on hollow-core photonic-crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fluorescence/Raman scattering in a liquid-core optical fiber waveguide based on hollow-core photonic-crystal fibers was demonstrated. 10 times of signal enhancement in a 6-cm long fiber was achieved. Different PCFs showed different enhancement factors.

articleTitle: Fast photorefractive self-focusing in InP:Fe semi-conductor at infrared wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The fast self-trapping behaviour of an infrared beam in photorefractive InP:Fe is studied experimentally and theoretically versus the intensity. The laser is shown to be self-focused in less than a millisecond at telecommunications intensities.

articleTitle: Ultrafast structure and polarization dynamics in nanolayered perovskites studied by femtosecond x-ray diffraction
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The polarization and lattice dynamics in a metal/ferroelectric/metal nanolayer system is analyzed by femtosecond x-ray diffraction. Optically induced giant stress in the metal layers can switch off the ferroelectric polarization within 2 ps.

articleTitle: 1.5-μm band hong-ou-mandel experiment using photon pairs generated in two independent optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: I report the first Hong-Ou-Mandel experiment using two photon pairs in the 1.5-μm band that are generated in two independent dispersion shifted fibers. A quantum interference with 53% visibility was observed.

articleTitle: Strong nuclear contribution to the optical Kerr effect in niobium oxide containing glasses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electronic and nuclear contributions to nonlinear optical properties of niobium oxide-based glasses have been measured using third harmonic generation and pump-probe techniques. Discrepancies with Hellwarth's model have been evidenced for niobium oxide concentrations above 30mol%, probably due to extra specific collective vibrational modes.

articleTitle: Scanning photocurrent microscopy in semiconducting carbon nanotube transistors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Scanning photocurrent measurements are demonstrated in individual carbon nanotube field effect transistors. Photocurrent images in conjunction with the electrical conductance measurement elucidate the properties of metal-CNT interfaces, especially the electron band alignment at the contact.

articleTitle: Laser emission from quantum dots in high-Q micropillar cavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on laser emission from a low number of InGaAs quantum dots embedded in high-Q micropillar laser structures. Resonance tuning of single quantum dots allows the observation of pronounced single dot lasing effects.

articleTitle: Synthesis of monodispersed DLC nanoparticles in intense optical field by femtosecond laser ablation of liquid benzene
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a noble fabrication technique of highly monodispersed diamond-like carbon (DLC) nanoparticles in intense optical field (≈10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) by femtosecond pulsed laser ablation (PLA) directly from the liquid benzen.

articleTitle: Single attosecond pulse generation using a seed harmonic pulse train
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically present a new scheme of single attosecond pulse generation which does not require few-cycle lasers, based on enhanced harmonic generation by simultaneous irradiation of driving laser and seed harmonic pulse train.

articleTitle: The impact of ultrashort femtosecond pulse-shaping technology for micromachining
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrashort laser pulses improve micromachining but they suffer significant phase distortions when focused by microscope objectives. Breakthrough technology to correct high order phase distortions is used to improve the machining characteristics of metals and semiconductors.

articleTitle: Probing attosecond kinetic physics in strongly coupled plasmas
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate intense laser-cluster interaction via molecular dynamics, finding that laser intensity controls the plasma coupling strength. By observing the destruction of collective effects, we determined sub-femtosecond collision frequencies for strongly coupled plasmas.

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring of atmospheric aerosol at New Haven, CT for fluorescence spectra, particle size and concentration
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A real-time aerosol-particle monitoring system is developed to measure size, concentration, and UV-laser-induced-fluorescence spectra. Data for atmospheric particles at New Haven, CT are measured over 48-hours and heirarchically cluster into various categories.

articleTitle: Ultrafast intervalley transitions in GaN single crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied time-resolved intervalley transitions of electrons between the conduction band Γ and L valleys in bulk GaN crystals using a two-color, femtosecond, pump-probe technique. The transition threshold and intervalley scattering times were determined.

articleTitle: Strong field coherent control with simple pulse shapes: Towards shaped pulse spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the dependence of molecular fragmentation on a simple pulse shape parameterization at different intensities. The results indicate that dynamic Stark shifts of intermediate resonances play an important role in closed loop learning control.

articleTitle: Industrial applications of laser direct-write processing: a review
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The use of laser direct-write (LDW) in advanced manufacturing processes is on the increase. This paper will review current industrial applications of LDW worldwide, and discuss the future prospects for LDW technologies.

articleTitle: Surface plasmons in ordered and disordered chains of metal nanospheres
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe two types of surface plasmons in ordered and disordered chains. The second kind is mediated by far-field interaction and is affected by Ohmic and radiative losses much less than the first kind.

articleTitle: High repetition rate passively Q-switched erbium-doped fiber laser incorporating an electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a novel passively Q-switched fiber laser using an electro-absorption modulator (EAM) as a saturable absorber. The fast response time of the EAM enables the Q-switched fiber laser to operate at high repetition rate.

articleTitle: Transient fluorescence excited by oscillating interference pattern in er-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments on transverse detection of transient fluorescence excited by oscillating interference pattern in Er-doped fiber in spectral range 1480-1600nm are reported. This technique is used for evaluation of local amplitude of the recorded population grating.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in microring-loaded Mach-Zehnder interferometer fabricated from perfluorocyclobutyl (PFCB)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that all-optical switching in a microring-loaded Mach-Zhender interferometer fabricated from PFCB is possible, and obtained a response pulse width of about 30ps and a maximum modulation depth of 3.8 dB.

articleTitle: Effects of polarization-dependent loss and fiber birefringence on photon-pair entanglement in fiber-optic channels
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum communication requires that photon-pair entanglement be preserved as the photons are distributed to remote locations. We model the effects of loss and birefringence on polarization-entangled photon pairs propagating in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Optical flip-flop operation using an AR-coated distributed feedback laser diode
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new concept for all-optical flip-flops is introduced using a single DFB laser diode. When injecting external light into the laser, two stable states can be obtained. We show numerically that optical pulses allow switching.

articleTitle: Vector π pulse soliton in coherent optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We found a novel type of vector soliton pulse in a medium with linear loss and nonlinear gain from the coherent resonant interaction of light with two-level atoms exhibiting a degenerate upper state.

articleTitle: Control of photon tunneling decay in engineered optical waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Acceleration and deceleration of photon tunneling decay is theoretically demonstrated in an engineered waveguide-array structure, which provides an optical realization of quantum mechanical decay control proposed for macroscopic quantum tunneling.

articleTitle: Spin relaxation in charge tunable InP quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optically pumped spins of doped electrons are partially preserved up to submillisecond and its dephasing time is 1.7ns. Spin relaxation in charge tunable InP quantum dots was extensively studied by dynamical and static optical orientation.

articleTitle: Relaxation oscillations in neodymium random lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using the developed analytical model, we adequately describe relaxation oscillations in the Nd0.5La0.5Al3(BO3)4 random laser. Anomalously long series of stimulated emission pulses are observed in the (Nd:BFAP)0.75(Cr:YAG)0.25 random laser.

articleTitle: Pulsed high duty cycle operation of λ ˜ 8μm quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on high duty-cycle pulsed and burst-mode operation of λ ˜ 8μm quantum cascade lasers under ambient conditions for photo-acoustic spectroscopy. An optimum in average optical power and efficiency is seen around 800kHz and 50% duty-cycle.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of surface plasmon-enhanced metal-semiconductor-metal traveling wave photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and analyze the bandwidth and efficiency issues of surface-plasmonresonance (SPR) enhanced metal-semiconductor-metal traveling-wave photodetectors. With strong field confinement near the nano-sized metal fingers, SPR-effect is found to greatly enhance the device's highspeed performance.

articleTitle: Ultra-flat spectrum, multiwavelength operation in an erbium-doped fiber laser using power-clamping effect
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel mechanism which utilizes power-clamping effect to realize stable and uniform multiwavelength oscillations in an EDFL is proposed and demonstrated. Up to 50 wavelengths oscillations with wavelength spacing of 0.8 nm has been achieved.

articleTitle: Direct dissociation and laser modulated predissociation of N2+
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare the dissociation energy of N2+ in 800 nm and 400 nm ultrafast laser fields. This comparison not only exposes multiphoton resonance but also reveals ionization into a Floquet manifold.

articleTitle: A novel confocal fiber-optic laser method for exact intraocular lens dioptric power measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on a fiber-optic confocal design, we have developed a simple, accurate, objective and quick method for exact focal length measurement of both positive and negative intraocular lenses providing a spatial resolution exceeding 1 μm.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional defect modes in optically induced photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Localized linear modes due to bandgap guidance in two-dimensional photonic lattices with a repulsive defect are investigated theoretically. It is shown that the negative defect can not only guide fundamental modes, but also dipole modes and vortex modes.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of spontaneous two-photon emission from semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe experimentally efficient spontaneous two-photon emission from semiconductors exhibiting wide two-photon spectrum only 4 orders of magnitude lower than the intensity of single-photon emission. Blue shift is interpreted by k-dependence of the matrix element

articleTitle: Effects of turbulence on the transverse position-momentum entanglement of biphotons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Entangled biphotons propagating through a turbulent medium are studied. We analyze the dependence of the transverse position-momentum entanglement of the photons on coherence diameter by taking a quadratic approximation to the wave-structure function.

articleTitle: An all-fiber-optic confocal interference microscope using low-coherence near-infrared light source
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An all-fiber-optic confocal interference microscope using a broadband near-infrared light source is demonstrated. Detection of interference fringes increases sensitivity and usage of a broadband source reduces undesirable interference between optical components.

articleTitle: Analytical dynamics of optical similaritons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analytically describe the attraction of parabolic pulses towards a self-similar state in weakly dispersive nonlinear fibers with linear gain.

articleTitle: Photon-number-resolving capabilities of a semiconductor quantum dot, optically gated, field-effect transistor
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the photon-number-resolving capabilities of a novel quantum dot, optically gated, field-effect transistor cooled to 4 K. Peaks are observed in the detector's response to highly attenuated laser pulses in accordance with Poisson statistics.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal surface mode laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated lasing from a high quality-factor photonic crystal surface mode, which brings several advantages for easy fabrication and efficient coupling. Temporal measurements indicate nearly ring-down time limited response.

articleTitle: Attosecond two-slit interference controlled by carrier-envelope phase
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonics generation was polarization gated with few-cycle laser pulses to produce two attosecond pulses with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> XUV photons. The spectrum interference of the two pulses is affected by the carrier-envelope phase like in Young's experiments.

articleTitle: Doping effect on carrier occupation and transport in InAs/GaAs quantum dot infrared photodetectors: A capacitance-voltage spectroscopy study
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Impurity centers induced by dopants in InAs/GaAs quantum-dot systems affect energy level occupation and carrier transport in multi-layer QDIPs. In order to better understand doping effects and to optimize device performance, capacitance-voltage spectra are investigated.

articleTitle: Spin dynamics in an antiferromagnetic spin-1 condensate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe coherent spin dynamics and measure ground state populations in an antiferromagnetic spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate. At a critical value of the quadratic Zeeman shift, the oscillations display a resonance in oscillation period.

articleTitle: 97% top hat efficiency, 4 J/cm2 damage threshold compression gratings
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High diffraction efficiency all-dielectric pulse compression grating is reported with a close to 100% flat top over more than 20 nm spectral width around 800 nm wavelength and more than 4 J/cm2 damage threshold.

articleTitle: Advanced femtosecond lasers in Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We solved the stability, life-time and cost problems of femtosecond lasers and opened the door to their huge commercial market in near future. Femtosecond lasers will be used in the semiconductor and LCD manufacturing factory

articleTitle: Nonlinearity and localization in disordered lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first experimental study of Anderson Localization effects in a periodic potential in the presence of both disorder and nonlinearity, demonstrating that self-focusing enhances localization effects driven by disorder.

articleTitle: Photonic torque microscope
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A statistical analysis of the movement of an optically trapped sub-micron sphere in an external rotational force field permits us to measure the torque exerted on the sphere.

articleTitle: New gap solitons in two-dimensional photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate new types of gap solitons in 2D photonic lattices such as dipole-array gap solitons. These solitons bifurcate from a superposition of Bloch modes at edges of higher Bloch bands.

articleTitle: Practical anti-microbial surfaces on nylon and polyester by UV photochemistry
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Surface radicals generated by 193 nm (nylon) or 172 nm (PET) UV light afford strongly antimicrobial amine functionality by grafting or by transformation. They are broadly effective in the lab and significantly viable in the field.

articleTitle: Coupled-cavity QED using planar photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new technique for controlling cavity-QED by indirectly coupling two planar-photoniccrystal nanocavities through an integrated waveguide is presented. The resulting optical response of a single-quantum-dot is shown to be profoundly influenced by a distant cavity.

articleTitle: All-optical generation and detection of coherent acoustic phonons in GaN single crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report experimental and theoretical studies on time-resolved generation and detection of coherent acoustic phonons in bulk GaN single crystals with an ultrafast two-color pump-probe technique. Optically-induced electronic stress is responsible for the phonon generation.

articleTitle: MegaJoule NIF
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Commissioning of the first 48 of 192 laser beams at the National Ignition Facility has resulted in the first-ever operational MegaJoule laser. A review of the laser performance and experimental campaign plans will be presented.

articleTitle: Role of radiation and surface plasmon in optical interactions between nano-objects on metal surface
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It was recently suggested that both radiation and surface plasmon participate in optical interactions between nano-objects on metal surface. We investigate their individual contributions and demonstrate the substantial role of radiation for nano-objects with subwavelength-spacing.

articleTitle: Scalability of line excitation THz arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new THz array method is proposed based on the photoconductive line excitation. We present experimental demonstration of the scalability of the radiated THz power based on the number of antenna elements illuminated.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in a diamond configuration: Experiments with rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate four-wave mixing in rubidium vapor using a diamond configuration that includes the 5s, 5p and 6s levels. A model that includes Doppler broadening qualitatively explains some of the observations.

articleTitle: Direct Laser acceleration of electrons in the corrugated plasma waveguide
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Direct electron acceleration by a radially polarized laser pulse can be quasi-phase matched in a corrugated plasma channel [1]. Modest laser pulses (1 mJ, 100fs) could give large gradients (> 10 MV/cm) over many centimeters.

articleTitle: Single-shot THz pulse characterization with dual echelons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dual echelon optics is implemented to enable single-shot terahertz pulse characterization. This reported embodiment produces sequentially delayed multi-beamlets allowing two-dimensional electro-optic imaging with a time window of >10 ps and <25 fs temporal step size.

articleTitle: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy Infrared emission from inorganic and organic substances
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The mid-infrared emission from a laser-induced-breakdown process between 2 to 5.75 μm was probed for the first time. Emission features from oxygenated carbon-containing breakdown fragments and from alkali metal-containing breakdown fragments have been successfully identified.

articleTitle: A bright and compact source of polarization entangled photons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a source of polarization entangled photons that uses periodically poled potassium titanyl phosphate and interferometers based on polarization beam displacers to achieve stable operation with few critical alignments.

articleTitle: Dissociative ionization of an aligned molecular sample
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate dissociative ionization of aligned N2 molecules using intense ultrafast laser pulses. We find surprising differences in the yields of N2++, N+(1, 0) and N+(1, 1) as a function of molecular axis-laser polarization angle.

articleTitle: Time- and spectrally-resolved PL study of a regular array of InP/InAs/InP core-multishell nanowires
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time- and spectrally-resolved PL from a periodic array of InP/InAs/InP core-multishell nanowires is presented. InAs layer shows multipeak PL spectra. PL decay is nonexponential and very slow, with decay rate depending on energy.

articleTitle: Measuring group velocity of surface plasmons by surface plasmon interferometry
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broadband optical transmission spectra of metal films with subwavelength slit-groove pairs show pronounced interference fringes by surface plasmons travelling between slits and grooves. Interferometric fringe analysis provides accurate values for group velocity of surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Plasma density inside femtosecond laser filaments in air
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a spectroscopic way to measure the plasma density of femtosecond laser filaments in air by using Stark broadening of the oxygen atomic fluorescence line. This method could also be applied to multiple filamentation.

articleTitle: Integration of a tunable optical micro-cavity for single atom detection on an atom chip
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent experiments demonstrated single-atom detection using microscopic optical cavities. Here we present an optical micro-cavity whose length can be tuned using an electrostatic comb-drive. This design is suitable for integration into a silicon atom chip.

articleTitle: Pump beams homogenization for Terawatt / Petawatt class Ti:Sapphire amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our goal is to design robust configurations for Terawatt/Petawatt-class power amplifiers. We investigate the processes involved in Ti:Sa pumping: damage threshold of amplifying material, beam transport (relay-image or homogenization) and coherence properties of pump lasers.

articleTitle: Generation of photon pairs with engineered spectral properties by spontaneous four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the generation of photon pairs by spontaneous four-wave mixing in microstructured optical fibers. We show that it is possible to engineer states with specific spectral entanglement properties suitable for quantum information processing applications.

articleTitle: Tunable repetition-rate ultrawideband monocycle pulse generation by using optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique for generating ultrawideband monocycle pulse with repetition-rate tuning capability based on fiber optical parametric amplifier. High quality monocycle pulse with repetition rate up to 4.2GHz is successfully generated.

articleTitle: Optical isolator /polarizer based on a rectangular waveguide with helical grooves
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Rectangular waveguide with slanted grooves in its sidewalls can be used as an optical isolator/polarizer due to the chirality effect. Even the crudest implementations of chirality are shown to exhibit high circular dichroism.

articleTitle: Isotropic photonic magnetoresistance: A new phenomenon at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate isotropic photonic magnetoresistive behaviour in the THz transmission through highly porous ferromagnetic particle collections. Experimental evidence suggests a morphological origin of the isotropic magnetic phenomenon.

articleTitle: Interaction-induced localization of self-defocusing discrete solitons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tilted beams, propagating in the self-defocusing regime of a waveguide array, away from a soliton, are shown to refocus due to the nonlinear interaction, emerging in intermediate sites as function of the relative phase.

articleTitle: Superfluorescence from high-density magneto-plasmas: Mixing, temperature, and excitation pulsewidth dependence
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast cooperative recombination from dense electron-hole plasmas in quantum wells is reported as a function of energy level mixing, temperature, and excitation pulse width under strong magnetic fields (up to 31 T).

articleTitle: Cusp solitons in exponentially nonlinear nanosuspensions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that cusp-like solitons are possible in exponentially nonlinear nano-particle suspensions. The dynamics and stability properties of this new class of waves are examined in detail.

articleTitle: Dynamics of exciton recombination in InAs quantum dots embedded in InGaAs/GaAs quantum well
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using time-resolved pump-probe differential photoluminescence technique, exciton decay time was measured to significantly increase as temperature was increased in InAs quantum dots embedded in an InGaAs/GaAs quantum well.

articleTitle: Discrimination between strain and temperature by using holey fibers-based long-period fiber gratings with different air hole size
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a simple and flexible scheme for simultaneous measurement of strain and temperature based on long-period fiber gratings inscribed in versatile holey fibers with various air-hole sizes.

articleTitle: Advances in high efficiency diode laser pump sources suitable for pumping Nd:YAG systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nd:YAG systems are conventionally pumped at 808-nm. Direct upper-level pumping at 885-nm leads to lower heat. Diode laser pumps sources now provide power with efficiency close to 70% at both wavelengths, offering significant system benefits.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced raman with nano-holes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of raman gain efficiency and chromatic dispersion of hole-assisted fiber: influence of bend
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Raman gain efficiency and chromatic-dispersion of a hole-assisted fiber with and without minimum allowable bending radius are measured. Numerical predictions from the theory are shown to be in good agreement with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Intracavity beam addition for energy scaling with a six-mirror cavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We presemt a novel and compact six-mirror cavity configuration to combine four beams intracavity for energy scaling. A single beam output exceeding 453 mJ with 165µs duration is obtained, with the combination efficiency of 90.7%.

articleTitle: Secret key distribution using differential-phase-shift keyed macroscopic coherent light
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quantum key distribution scheme utilizing quantum noise is proposed. It uses macroscopic coherent light that is phase-modulated by {-δ, δ} and direct differential detection. It has possibility for high data rate.

articleTitle: Circular dichroism in double-layer chiral metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experiments and numerical calculations for chiral metamaterials composed of double-layer gammadions. The excitation of anti-symmetric magnetic modes leads to pronounced circular dichroism. In contrast, polarization effects are negligible in corresponding single layer gammadions.

articleTitle: Divalent ytterbium in ytterbium doped aluminosilicate glass - aspects on photodarkening in fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that divalent ytterbium ions are present in ytterbium doped aluminosilicate glass. The presence of Yb2+-ions may influence the formation of induced color centers in ytterbium doped fiber lasers leading to reduced performance.

articleTitle: Low quantum-defect laser oscillation by high intensity pumping at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ytterbium laser oscillations at 980.6 nm and 983.0 nm are observed by high intensity 978.1 nm pumping of around 1 MW/cm2 at room temperature. Corresponding quantum defects are 0.26 % and 0.50 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Nano-particle ions and atoms
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Charged particles attracted to metallic nano-particles via radial potentials exhibit hydrogenic quantum states. Two-particle electronic states exist with different correlations energies and tuning of the plasmon resonance to the electronic transistions results in large radiative effects.

articleTitle: Broadband attosecond pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experiments on the control over spectral amplitude and phase of attosecond pulses, using metallic and semiconductor thin-film dispersive filters. A pulse duration as short as 130 as is obtained.

articleTitle: Light transfer, parallel focusing and demultiplexing using negative refraction in photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate three important functions utilizing the negative refraction of light in the photonic crystal slab, for the first time. They will be applicable to a sophisticated in-plane free space optical network.

articleTitle: Excited state absorption cross-section spectrum of Chlorophyll A
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper reports on the nonlinear absorption (reverse saturation of absorption and saturation of absorption) spectrum of Chlorophyll A solution obtained through the white light continuum Z-scan technique.

articleTitle: The creation of Gaussian beams with extremely high orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider theoretically and experimentally an array of Gaussian beams whose axes lie on the surface of a hyperboloid of revolution. We show that such beams array can carry very high orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: Real-time PMD monitoring using a DOP ellipsoid based on PSO technique
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: DOP ellipsoid can be used as PMD monitoring signal for automatic PMD compensation. We introduced the particle swarm optimization algorithm into obtaining real-time DOP ellipsoid with high precision only by 100 sampling SOP data.

articleTitle: Slow-light trapping in a photonic crystal slab
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a general scheme to trap slow-light in a photonic crystal slab and achieve high Q/V ratio with a fabrication tolerant design, well suited for low-threshold microlasers and cavity quantum electrodynamics.

articleTitle: High resolution two photon excitation spectroscopy by pulse shaping an ultrabroad bandwidth femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-resolution two-photon excitation spectroscopy of natural and synthetic fluorescent biological molecules is demonstrated using an ultra-broad-bandwidth (over 400 nm) femtosecond laser. Selective excitation was achieved using a series of specially designed phase and amplitude masks.

articleTitle: Development of high efficiency green and deep green light emitters in piezoelectric group-iii nitrides
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Green and deep-green light emitting diodes are still the weakest link in energy efficient Solid-State Lighting. We analyze the limiting factors of the external quantum efficiency and summarize our approach of dislocation and polarization control.

articleTitle: Narrowband pulsed polarization-entangled photon source for free-space quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a narrowband pulsed source of polarization-entangled photons based on parametric downconversion in a phase-stable Sagnac interferometer that is suitable for free-space quantum key distribution with high key generation rates.

articleTitle: Wakefield acceleration of quasi-monoenergetic 200 MeV electrons in nitrogen and helium gas targets
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quasi-monoenergetic electron beams of energies over 200MeV with high flux are generated from both nitrogen and helium gas with a modest laser power of 6.5TW. 2D PIC simulations are in progress to compare to experiments.

articleTitle: Transformation of surface states from Shockley-like to Tamm-like in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate how the asymmetry of surface potential affects the Shockley surface states in photonic crystals and demonstrate the transformation of the Shockley surface states into the Tamm states for the first time.

articleTitle: Detection and identification of a water mixture of E. coli cells and B. subtilis spores with raman chemical imaging microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Raman chemical imaging microscopy was used to visualize and discriminate between biological substances with Raman spectral database identification. Water suspensions were investigated for mixtures of different concentrations of E. coli and Bacillus subtilis spores.

articleTitle: Studies of ultra-broadband spontaneous parametric downconversion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider collinear downconversion in a type-1 configuration with degeneracy near the crystal's zero group-velocity dispersion frequency. A fractional frequency bandwidth of 0.53 is observed, corresponding to a 1080nm range about the 1885nm degenerate wavelength.

articleTitle: Mechanistic comparison of different solutions found in closed-loop quantum control simulations
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate how variable number affects mechanistic complexity in solutions found using closed-loop learning control. We find that we can facilitate our mechanistic understanding by initially using fewer variables for the optimization.

articleTitle: Polariton emission from an electrically injected semiconductor device
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first observation of polariton emission from an electrically pumped semiconductor device, operating up-to room temperature. The system is a quantum cascade electroluminescent structure, embedded in a planar microcavity.

articleTitle: Optical probing of laser-produced plasmas for laboratory simulations of magnetic astrophysical jets
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate laboratory simulations of magnetic astrophysical jets using optical probing. We have observed differences in laser-produced plasmas with and without a magnetic field using interferometric measurements.

articleTitle: Optimized photon pair generation by parametric downconversion in nonlinear photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore the generation of photon pairs by the process of parametric downconversion in nonlinear photonic crystals. In particular, we show that careful design of the photonic crystal, can lead to nearly-factorable two-photon states.

articleTitle: Investigation of fast light in long optical fibers based on stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple method to generate a negative time delay in SBS-based fast-light systems using Brillouin gain and loss is shown. We achieved a maximum negative time delay of 32.4 ns in one long fiber segment.

articleTitle: Observation of fast and slow light in a microsphere-optical fiber system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed both -8ns negative and 21ns positive delays in the optical pulse propagation through a microsphere-fiber system on the under and over coupling conditions, respectively, which are explained by a directional coupling theory.

articleTitle: Destructive interference of high harmonics generated in mixed gases
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate destructive interference of high harmonics generated in a He-Ne mixed gas, which offers novel methods for observing the underlying attosecond electron dynamics as well as shaping harmonic pulses and measuring harmonic phases.

articleTitle: General two-dimensional coupled-cavity microring filter architectures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-dimensional coupled-mirroring arrays of the most general topology are proposed for realizing optical filters with arbitrary spectral responses. A method for synthesizing these filters with optimal design is presented along with numerical examples.

articleTitle: Intrinsic photoconductivity of P3HT films measured by time-resolved THz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intrinsic photoconductivities of P3HT polymers were measured and compared by using optical pump-THz probe spectroscopy. The charge carrier mobility shows a clear dependence on the molecular weight and dispersion index of the polymers.

articleTitle: Negative index bands in sub-wavelength metallic gratings
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe negative group index surface plasmons in nano-structured metallic gratings. The periods and amplitudes of silver gratings exhibiting negative group index, as well as the attenuation lengths of the negative-index surface waves, are derived.

articleTitle: Nonlocal surface-wave solitons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate, experimentally and theoretically, surface-wave solitons occurring at the interface between a dielectric medium (air) and a nonlinear material with high range of nonlocality.

articleTitle: Talbot effect and self-pumped phase conjugation in photorefractive liquid crystal light-valves
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that Talbot effect can be used to enhance the two-wave mixing gain of two photorefractive liquid crystal light-valves in cascade and that self-pumped phase conjugation can be obtained in an optical feedback scheme.

articleTitle: Soliton transitions in optical lattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is theoretically shown that Bloch (band to band) and soliton (gap to gap) transitions are possible in optical lattices. This can be achieved in waveguide arrays with modulated channel widths along the propagation direction.

articleTitle: Generation of telecom-band indistinguishable photon pairs in dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a 50/50 Sagnac-loop configuration to spatially separate degenerate photon pairs created via four-photon scattering in dispersion-shifted fiber, A Hong-Ou-Mandel dip with visibility > 94% is observed.

articleTitle: Thermo-plasmonic resonances in hybrid metallo-dielectric nano-particles: Towards tunable standalone nano-sensors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically investigate the intense nano-focusing of light through a novel family of metallo-dielectric nano-particles mediated by thermo-plasmonic resonances. The results show a significant sensitivity of the plasmonic resonance to temperature and environmental fluctuations.

articleTitle: Multiple Wavelength Emission From Semipolar InGaN/GaN Quantum Wells Selectively Grown by MOCVD
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiple wavelength emission is experimentally observed from semipolar InGaN/GaN quantum wells selectively grown by MOCVD. Selective growth rates on different mask opening areas result in a multiple wavelength emission from the same wafer.

articleTitle: Evaluating micromachining capabilities of high power diode pumped solid state mode-locked and q-switched ultraviolet laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The micromachining capabilities of two newly developed DPSS mode-locked and q-switched UV lasers have been evaluated by studying ablation of commonly used materials in semiconductor, microelectronics, and solar cell industry.

articleTitle: AIRIS remote detection for chemical vapor clouds: systems design and detection algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Detection and tracking of chemical vapors at kilometer distances constitute an important component in early warning for the US military. The Adaptive Infrared Imaging Spectroradiometer (AIRIS) passively interrogates chemical vapor infrared emission spectra.

articleTitle: Enhanced ZnO band-gap emission of electroluminescence from ZnO nanoparticles/Organic nanocomposites using a hole-transporting material
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report electroluminescence from ZnO nanoparticle-based devices prepared by the spincoaung process. The TPD enhances electrons and holes to recombine in the ZnO nanoparticles. The opamal device exhlbits a narrow spectrum at 392 nm.

articleTitle: Intense self-compressed carrier-envelope phase-locked few-cycle pulses at 2 µm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate filamentation at 2 µm using carrier-envelope phase (CEP) stabilized 55 fs, 330 μJ pulses from an OPA. The ultra-broadband output is self-compressed below 3-optical cycles with 270 μJ and preserves the CEP offset.

articleTitle: Blue-shifting of coherent plasmon radiation due to Landau damping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Restricting the wave vector of coherent plasmons excited by ultrashort laser pulses results in a frequency blue-shift of the emitted THz radiation, consistent with the onset of Landau damping.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional electromagnetic metamaterials with non-Maxwellian effective fields
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new class of electromagnetic metamaterial systems, whose long-wavelength behaviors cannot be described by Maxwell's equations in a uniform media, and instead possess much richer properties.

articleTitle: Optimizing Raman/EDFA hybrid amplifier based on dualorder stimulated Raman scattering of a single pump
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on dual-order stimulated-Raman-scattering of single pump laser, hybrid Raman/EDFA is realized by introducing Erbium doped fiber (EDF) within the span. Gain and noise performance can be improved by optimizing the position of EDF.

articleTitle: Optically pumped potassium vapor laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an optically pumped continuous wave Potassium vapor laser operating in a single longitudinal and a single transverse mode at 770 nm. The measured value of the slope efficiency was 20%.

articleTitle: Plasmon enhancement of photoinduced resistivity changes in Bi1-xCaxMnO3 Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Considerable increase of the photoinduced resistivity changes was found in Bi0.4Ca0.6MnO3 thin films after depositing gold nanoparticles on the surface due to resonant enhancement of local electromagnetic field in the vicinity of the gold nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Study of transient effects in photo-excited semiconducting polymer and bulk heterojunctions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transient dynamics of photoexcited carriers in MEH-PPV, PCBM-C60 and their blend is investigated by THz-TDS using a 400nm optical pump and terahertz probe. Free and bound carriers are revealed in the measurement of the complex conductivity.

articleTitle: Multiscale Bessel beams from tunable acoustic gradient index of refraction lenses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A device that uses acoustic waves within a fluid to phase modulate an incident laser beam and form tunable multiscale Bessel beams is presented. This device is both modelled and experimentally characterized.

articleTitle: 40 GHz all-optical clock recovery using cross-absorption in an electroabsorption modulator inside a fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 40 GHz all-optical clock recovery system using an erbium-doped fiber laser that incorporates a 10 GHz electro-absorption modulator and a linear optical amplifier. We successful recovered 40 GHz clock signals from a 40 Gb/s pseudo random bit sequences. Stable pulses with pulsewidth of 6 ps and timing jitter of 300 fs are obtained.

articleTitle: Hollow nano-magnetic resonators mediated by photothermal effects: Towards the realization of highly-tunable mid-infrared negative permeability
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a rigorous-coupled-wave analysis combined with a thermo-optical sensitivity prediction scheme, we show that nano-engineered magnetic resonators exhibit strong tunable magnetic response in mid-infrared, which can be effectively used for realizing a negative magnetic permeability.

articleTitle: Imaging electron trajectories in laser wakefield cavity using betatron x-ray radiation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that betatron x-ray radiation provides a direct imaging of electrons trajectories accelerated in laser wakefields. Electron excursions down to 0.7 μm ± 0.2 μtm have been measured in our parameter regime.

articleTitle: Pressure-broadening coefficient of water vapor measured with a high resolution, coherent tunable THz-wave spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: we developed a table-top, coherent tunable THz-wave spectrometer based on an injection-seeded THz-wave parametric generator, which was employed to study the far-infrared rotational spectrum of water vapor, N2 collision-broadening coefficient of water vapor is measured.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation spectroscopy of silicon quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The size effects in resonant nonlinear-optical response of silicon quantum dots are studied in the spectral interval of second-harmonic photon energies from 3.0 to 3.5 eV.

articleTitle: Stopping single photons in one-dimensional circuit quantum electrodynamics systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a mechanism to stop and time-reverse single photons in one-dimensional circuit quantum electrodynamics systems. The circuit can be designed to be of deep sub-wavelength scale, and can stop and store two photons in the system at the same time.

articleTitle: Streaking transient electric fields with laser accelerated proton beams
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A long range electric field with nanosecond duration and a localized field at the rear side of a laser irradiated foil have been investigated. This scenario was recorded with a newly developed streak measurement setup.
