articleTitle: Detection of gold in the facet of a failed semiconductor laser diode
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The damaged region of a failed semiconductor laser diode was analyzed using FIB nanotomography and 31) TOF-SIMS. Gold, a deep level trap, was found between the antireflective coating and the semiconductor facet.

articleTitle: Cesium 6S1/2 - 8S1/2 two-photon transition stabilized 822.5 nm diode laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cesium 6S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> - 8S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> two-photon transition stabilized 822.5 mn diode laser (CTSDL) is reported for the first time to our knowledge. We demonstrate that the CTSDL could be a reliable frequency reference.

articleTitle: Efficient source of single photons from charge- tunable quantum dots in a micropillar cavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single photon source is demonstrated using a novel oxide-apertured micropillar cavity embedded with InGaAs quantum dots. A bright 80 MHz count rate is enabled by the Purcell effect and charge-tuning of the quantum dots.

articleTitle: Optical measurements of heat and shock waves propagating in a dense plasma
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dynamics of heat and shock waves in a dense plasma were studied using timeresolved reflectivity measurements of the rear surface of an aluminum foil following femtosecond irradiation at ~5×1013 W/cm2.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical resonance in counterpropagating waves
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electromagnetically-induced absorption resonances in Hanle-configuration are experimentally and theoretically studied in the case of counterpropagating waves. The presence of a backward wave provides a significant increase of the amplitude. The results may be useful for magnetometry.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of modulational instability in the 1st and 2nd band of a self-defocusing nonlinear waveguide array
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed experimentally discrete modulational instability within the first two bands in a permanent nonlinear waveguide array fabricated in an iron-doped photorefractive lithium niobate crystal.

articleTitle: THz radiation from optically-induced magnetization in GaAs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A transient magnetization is induced in a semiconductor via optical spin injection by 100 fs, 800 nm circularly polarized pulses. The weak emitted THz radiation is identified against that from a much stronger photogalvanic source.

articleTitle: Spectral broadening of femtosecond laser pulses using a hollow fiber with symmetric pressure gradient
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a pulse compression technique using a symmetric pressure-gradient hollow fiber. This technique improves the spatial and spectral qualities of multi-mJ femtosecond laser pulses spectrally-broadened by self-phase modulation.

articleTitle: Laser-assisted electrical gating in a two-terminal device based on vanadium dioxide thin film
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In a two-terminal electrical device based on vanadium dioxide thin film, electrical gating has been demonstrated by illuminating a focused laser beam with a wavelength of ~1550 nm onto the selectively etched thin film.

articleTitle: Enhanced second order nonlinearity in AlGaAs microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second order nonlinear effects, such as second harmonic generation and parametric amplification, can be dramatically enhanced in microring resonator structures. The quasi-phase-matching is achieved based on the position dependence of polarization inside the ring resonator.

articleTitle: Observation of soft-mode hardening and broadening in SrTiO3 thin films by broadband terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Complex dielectric constants of SrTiO3 thin films have been measured using the broadband terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. The broad detection-bandwidth of the photoconductive antenna enables us to clarify soft-mode dispersions as well as the TO2 mode.

articleTitle: High field physics with XUV pulses from the free electron laser in hamburg: Atoms and clusters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Irradiation of clusters with intense VUV radiation pulses has shown unexpected high energy deposition and ionisation mechanisms different from the optical regime. The extension to shorter wavelengths (XUV) enables the direct ionisation of innershell electrons.

articleTitle: 9 dB Quadrature squeezing at 860 nm with periodically-poled KTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We generate a squeezed Vacuum state at 860 nm with a periodically-poled KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal as a nonlinear medium of an optical parametric oscillator We observe -9.0±0.2 dB of squeezing with local oscillator phase locked.

articleTitle: Slow-light soliton dynamics with relaxation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We solved the problem of soliton dynamics in the presence of relaxation. We demonstrate that the spontaneous emission of atoms is strongly suppressed due to nonlinearity. The spatial shape of the soliton is well preserved.

articleTitle: The generation and temporal correlation measurement of triphoton
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A triphoton EPR-GHZ state, entangled in energy and momentum, is generated by using a hexagonally poled photonic crystal. The measured third order correlation function G3 (t1, t2, t3) has clear shown the entangled nature of the three-photon system.

articleTitle: Electronically tunable photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electronically tunable diffraction gratings based on 2D arrays of colloidal particles are presented and measured and modelled results show good agreement. Modelled results for 3D arrays show tunable reflectivity is possible the visible wavelength range.

articleTitle: High-energy few-cycle pulse generation in a filament for relativistic applications at kHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient generation of 9.5-fs 1.8 mJ pulses by filamentation. The pulse wave front, the low energy fluctuations and the good temporal contrast make this source suited for relativistic laser-solid experiments at kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: The study on 3D image laser sensing technology of welding seam
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using Moiré Pattern technology, a 3D image laser sensing system of weld seam was introduced. The realization method of the system and its image processing were explained. 3D weld seam images were obtained with experiments.

articleTitle: Patterning and integration of polyfluorene polymers on micropixellated UV AlInGaN light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The integration of polyfluorene polymer micro-pixels onto GaN-based micropixellated UV Light Emitting Diodes is demonstrated. Polymer down-converted visible emission from these hybrid organic/inorganic electroluminescent micro-arrays is achieved.

articleTitle: Few-cycle terawatt optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification system using an Yb:YLF chirped-pulse amplification pump laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an ultra-broadband optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification system with a 400 nm bandwidth pumped by two broadband pulses delivered from a liquid nitrogen cooled Yb:YLF chirped-pulse amplification laser.

articleTitle: High brightness injection-seeded table-top soft x-ray laser using a dense plasma amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of an extremely bright λ=32.6nm laser beam with high spatial coherence by saturated amplification of high harmonic seed pulses in a soft x-ray laser plasma amplifier created heating a titanium target.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgaps in photonic crystal fibers with coated high-index inclusions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the photonic bandgaps in photonic crystal fibers coated with cylindrical high-index inclusions. Besides numerical modeling, we are studying the feasibility of the atomic layer deposition technique for producing the inclusions.

articleTitle: Development of 50J class repetitive laser based on Nd-doped silica glass
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high energy laser oscillation (29 J) in Nd doped silica glass (Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>: 1.34wt%, ϕ30 mm × 300 mm) with high thermal shock parameter (12W/cm).

articleTitle: Characterization of the complex noise transfer function of a modelocked Ti: Sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the complex amplitude and phase noise transfer functions of a KLM Ti:sapphire laser by modulating the pump laser from 0.1 Hz to 10 MHz. The frequency dependence is in good agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Metal-less optical surface plasmon polariton
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a Surface Plasmon Polarition based guiding at the interface of a dielectric and semiconductor quantum well structure, exhibiting a negative electrical permeability and possible gain in the vicinity of optical transition resonance.

articleTitle: "Slow" light in media of "Zero" dimension
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electromagnetic pulses propagating through a thin metal film, structured on the sub-wavelength scale, are significantly delayed and re-shaped.

articleTitle: Coherent contrast improvement by cross-polarized wave generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Contrast improvement filter based on cross-polarized wave generation is addressing the coherent contrast issue by flattening the spectral phase of the pulse. Theoretical and experimental evidence of this effect on pulse spectrum are presented.

articleTitle: Propagation of two photon states through dispersive media and spectral entanglement migration
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study entanglement migration between modulus and phase for parametric down-conversion photon pairs which propagate through dispersive media. In addition, we discuss a related dispersion suppression effect which occurs for factorable, highly asymmetric states.

articleTitle: A scheme to realize class B slow light buffer in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We proposed a scheme to realize Class B slow-light buffer in semiconductor optical amplifiers. With three electrical control signals, good characteristics of Class B buffer can be approached in SOA.

articleTitle: Far-field investigation of slow-light propagating below the light cone in planar photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A far-field technique is used to investigate the properties of optical waves propagating below the light cone in nanophotonic structures. As an example, dispersion curves for slow-light in photonic crystal waveguides are retrieved.

articleTitle: The effect of focal geometry on radiation from atomic ionization in ultrastrong/ultrafast laser field
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Larmor radiation calculated with non-paraxial approximation to the laser field peaks away from the laser propagation direction and has larger angular spread when compared to the calculation with plane wave approximation.

articleTitle: Temperature dependent and magnetic field dependent terahertz spectroscopy of In1-xMnxAs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report temperature and magnetic field dependent terahertz time domain spectroscopy measurements on InMnAs. The temperature dependent transmission is shown to vary with Mn content and applied magnetic field strength.

articleTitle: High Performance 800-1000nm single mode lasers using an asymmetric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the design and fabrication of high performance 800-1000 nm high power lasers using an asymmetric waveguide structure. The structure offers lower beam divergence, improved power kink and reduced resistively.

articleTitle: Incoherent solitons in effectively-instantaneous nonlocal nonlinear media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate incoherent spatial solitons in effectively instantaneous nonlocal nonlinear-media. This new kind of "ensemble-averaged solitons" has profound new features (e.g., random soliton's deflection) making it different than all previously observed coherent and incoherent solitons.

articleTitle: Selective alignment of spin isomers: The case of ortho and para nitrogen
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Double pulse excitation of fractional revivals of rotational wavepackets is demonstrated as an effective tool for spin-selective alignment in a multi-component mixture of molecular spin isomers.

articleTitle: Spontaneous pattern formation upon incoherent waves: From modulation-instability to dynamic equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study long-range propagation of spatially-incoherent light in non-instantaneous nonlinearities, and show that the system eventually reaches dynamic equilibrium, which depends only on the initial coherence, and not on the strength of the nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Nonclassicality and decoherence of photon-subtracted squeezed states
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss nonclassical properties of single-photon subtracted squeezed vacuum states and study its decoherence under different models, We find that the state is especially robust under phase diffusion model though its phase properties are lost.

articleTitle: A total internal reflection technique for time resolved measurements of index of refraction
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a method using total-internal reflection for measuring small index-of-refraction changes (Δn=1x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>). The technique overcomes requirements of diffraction-limited laser performance, is auto-calibrating, and paves the way for sensitive single-shot ultrafast measurements of material dynamics.

articleTitle: Emission Intensity Improvement of InGaN Ultraviolet Light-Emitting Diodes Grown on Wet-Etched Sapphire Substrates
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

articleTitle: Ultra-long range surface plasmon structures for plasmonic devices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our computations show that adding a thin, low-index dielectric adjacent to a thin metal layer dramatically increases the surface plasmon propagation length. This geometry allows the integration of plasmonic waveguides with metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) structures.

articleTitle: Efficient point defect engineered si light-emitting diode at 1.218 μm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a Si LED with an internal quantum efficiency ˜ 10 % using a novel approach to enhance light emission based on point defect engineering, which uses state-of-the art technology.

articleTitle: Co2+: GSGG as a saturable absorber for resonantly laser pumped 1.6µm Er:YAG laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Co:GSGG has excellent spectroscopic properties as a saturable absorber for resonantly laser-pumped 1.6 µm ErYAG at 1620nm (RT). Absorption, emission cross sections, lifetimes, modeling results are reported for 3-level gain/4-level absorber.

articleTitle: Ultrafast spectroscopy on photonic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review recent progress in the emerging field of photonic metamaterials, emphasizing two highlights connected with femtosecond pulses: time-of-flight experiments on negative-index metamaterials and harmonic generation on magnetic metamaterials.

articleTitle: Achieving sharp resonances in metamaterials via engaging "closed-modes"
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the new way of achieving sharp transmission and reflection resonances in sub-wavelength structured artificial materials.

articleTitle: 6.4W, narrow-line CW bismuth-doped fiber laser for frequency doubling to 590nm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 6.4W lasing output at 1178nm is obtained from a Bismuth-doped fiber laser pumped by 50W CW Ytterbium fiber laser. Narrow, below 0.2nm, linewidth shows a potential for frequency doubling to 589.

articleTitle: Compact, 65 W, 10-30 kHz, TEM00 - mode, Q-Switched, Side-Diode-Pumped Yb:YAG Laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a compact, side-diode-pumped, TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00-</sub> mode Yb:YAG laser capable of delivering 65 W of Q-switched output power at 10-30 kHz. Induced lensing in the composite crystal is compensated by the choice of resonator.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon assisted laser cooling of solids
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Threshold and efficiency of laser cooling can be significantly improved due to rapid energy transfer from semiconductor to metal heat sink via excitation of surface plasmon polaritons and their subsequent decay in the metal.

articleTitle: Intraoperative near-infrared fluorescence imaging
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a low-cost, safe, and easy to use NIR fluorescence intraoperative imaging system that permits the surgeon to see, in real time, surgical anatomy and invisible NIR fluorescence simultaneously.

articleTitle: Mesoscopic entanglement of atomic ensembles through non-resonant stimulated Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Atomic ensemble entanglement can be generated by measuring the Stokes fields and verified hy measuring thc readout anti-Stokes fields. We model the effects of practical factors and find achievable entanglement regimes at mesoscopic-level excitation.

articleTitle: Increase of ablation rate using burst mode femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the ablation rates of metals and dielectrics using a Ti:Sapphire oscillator. Prior work on burst ablation has been performed using high-power lasers and significant increases were observed. These two modalities will be compared.

articleTitle: Multiple-Wavelength Transmission using FP-LD for Increasing Upstream Capacity in Asymmetric TDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new technique for multi-wavelength upstream transmission in time division multiplexed-passive optical networks using FP-LDs at optical network units. The scheme increases upstream capacity without the use of costly higher speed burst-mode transceivers.

articleTitle: Periodic surface plasmon-enhanced diffraction in cholesteric liquid crystal grating
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Periodic surface plasmon-enhanced diffraction effect in cholesteric liquid crystal (CLC) grating is demonstrated. The CLC grating is a periodic structure and results in the excitation of a periodic surface plasmon. The surface plasmon-enhanced diffraction effect may be important in nano-optics applications.

articleTitle: Memory in nonlinear ionization of transparent dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show a reduction in the ionization threshold at previously ionized regions inside transparent solids. This forms a shot-to-shot memory that can lead to several unique nonlinear phenomena including the formation of nanostructures.

articleTitle: Joint spectrum mapping of polarization entanglement in parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral mapping of the polarization correlations of photon pairs from down-conversion in femtosecond regime reveals an imbalance between contributions from the two possible decay paths as the cause of low entanglement quality.

articleTitle: Coherence-based transverse measurement of synchrotron x-ray radiation from relativistic laser-plasma interaction and of laser-accelerated electrons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fresnel diffraction of x-ray beam from laser-plasma interaction shows incoherent-source diameter≤8 μm. Analysis shows this corresponds to accelerated electron profile in plasma agreeing with simulation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear nanoplasmonics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear optical properties associated with surface-plasmon excitations in metallic nanostructures hybridised with nonlinear molecules will be discussed. Nonlinear plasmonics provides a possibility to develop novel nonlinear metamaterials with enhanced functionalities and control light with light.

articleTitle: Analysis of entanglement in the double slit interference patterns of down converted photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the non-classical correlation of two entangled photons passing through a pair of double slits. The quantum state is reconstructed using quantum tomography based on the correlated interference patterns and slit images.

articleTitle: Single-shot time resolved expansion and emission measurements of proton-heated warm dense matter
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the simultaneous, single shot, time-resolved measurements of self-emission and free expansion of aluminum isochorically heated by laser generated MeV protons. In this way we measure the equation of state along an isochore.

articleTitle: The noise effect on pulses in passive mode-locking with unrestricted dispersive and dissipative parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the statistical properties of pulses in passive mode-locking with noise for unrestricted dispersive and dissipative parameters. We find exact general expressions for the pulse power and the time and phase jitters.

articleTitle: Micromachinining with tailored pulse parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments on different metals and silicon were conducted to optimize removal rate or surface finish with nanosecond pulses of different parameters. A special fiber laser allows independent adjustment of pulse parameters while keeping beamquality constant. Fiber lasers in MOPA configuration enable a tool for micro-machining that allows to independently adjust pulse parameters while keeping the beam quality constant. Such a fiber laser was developed delivering an average power of 11 W and a maximum pulse energy of 0.5 mJ for a wide range of pulse parameters at diffraction limited beam quality. The pulse duration is continuously adjustable in the range from 10 ns to cw, the repetition rate is continuously adjustable from from 10 kHz to 1 MHz while the pulse energy can be adjusted continuously up to 0.5 mJ. All parameters can be independently varied and the pulse shape is almost a rectangular. A scanner was adapted to the output of the fiber laser to determine removal rates by scanning the focused laser beam multiple times over an area of 1.8mm by 1.8mm. A 160mm and 80mm telecentric focusing lens was used resulting in 45μm, respectively 25 μm spot size and a maximum power density of 280 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 460 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Ablation experiments were carried out on stainless steel, nickel and silicon varying the repetition rate in the range from 20kH.z to IOOkHz, the pulse duration in the range from 20ns to 650ns and the scanner speed in the range from 100mmls to 800mmls. For stainless steel and nickel the average power was set to 2.25W using the 25μm spot size, while for silicon, the energy was kept constant at 45mJ for varying pulse duration. Fairly similar pulse parameters for maximum removal rate were found for all three materials. For stainless steel, a pulse duration of 320 ns, a repetition rate of 20 kHz, and a pulse energy of 113μJ resulted in the maximum removal rate of 0.46 mm3/min, while for nickel the optimum parameters were found with a pulse duration of 160ns, a repetition rate of 40 kHz and a pulse energy of 112μJ For silicon 320ns pulse duration at 100kHz and 45 mJ resulted in optimum removal. In single shot experiments a dramatic influence of pulse duration was found that for silicon with a clear optimum for removal rate and clean processing. This was not so apparent for the ablation of metals, even so a different set of parameters must be used to obtain best surface quality or maximum removal rate. It was found that for maximum removal rate, the scanner speed must be synchronized with repetition rate to achieve a pulse to pulse overlap of at least 70% and that increasing the repetition rate requires shorter pulses, e.g. 320ns at 20 kHz or 80ns at 100kHz. An optimum range of power density at the work piece was also identified to be in the range of 35MW/cm2 to 70MW/cm2. Lower densities are below ablation threshold, while higher power densities result in plasma shielding within the pulse.

articleTitle: High precision and high speed cutting of 4th generation OLED masks with LaserMicroJet®
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new micro-machining technology - the water jet guided laser, also called as LaserMicroJet® technology - has been developed for the manufacturing of sophisticated and heat sensitive OLED masks.

articleTitle: Improving fidelity of skewed output states of optical zeno gates
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have shown that high two-photon to one-photon absorption ratios are needed for a high fidelity free-standing Zeno CZ gate. Nevertheless, using this gate with distillation for cluster fusion can outperform linear optics fusion gate.

articleTitle: Temporal dynamics of optical-to-terahertz conversion in electro-optic crystal
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a theory of the optical-to-terahertz conversion of a femtosecond laser pulse with finite width in a slab of nonlinear crystal. This theory explains previous experiments and reveals new schemes for terahertz generation.

articleTitle: Measuring attosecond ionization dynamics inside dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We resolve attosecond dynamics of multiphoton ionization in solids. We subdivide the laser cycle using differential absorption between the major and the minor axes of elliptically polarized beam.

articleTitle: Effect of Raman-induced refractive index change on multi-pump raman-assisted four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated the contribution of Raman-induced refractive index change on the conversion efficiency bandwidth in Raman-assisted four-wave mixing. The contribution of the Raman-induced refractive index change can be significant when multi-Raman pumps are used.

articleTitle: Suppression of phase noise induced by intrachannel four-wave mixing using phase noise averagers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This work investigates a novel phase noise averagers to suppress IFWM-induced phase noise of RZ-DPSK signals. Both analytical and simulation results confirm that the IFWM-induced phase noise will be converged, even after an ultra-long transmission.

articleTitle: Mid-IR entangled-cavity doubly resonant OPO with back-conversion minimization and automated tuning
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Entangled cavity optical parametric oscillators are known as powerful devices to fulfill requirements for high resolution spectroscopy. We demonstrate here that output performances can be strongly improved by using a partial pump beam reflection.

articleTitle: Impulse-response reconstruction of a scattering medium with the Kramers-Kronig method
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Kramers-Kronig (KK) algorithm is implemented for the first time to obtain the optical impulse response of a diffusive medium and detect a concealed object. We achieve sub-picosecond resolution with simple fiber-optic (c-band) test equipment.

articleTitle: Enhancement of luminescence efficiency using surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We develop a rigorous theory of the enhancement of spontaneous emission from a lightemitting device via coupling with the surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs). Using the GaN/Ag system as an example we show that using SPPs pays off only for emitters that have low luminescence efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancement of single high harmonic generation from Sn and Sb Ion in laser-ablation plume at XUV region
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a single-high-harmonic enhancement at 47 and 37 nm by using the laser-ablation plume. Such an enhancement was caused by the multiphoton resonance with the strong radiative transition of the Sn and Sb ions.

articleTitle: Colloidal quantum dots in high-Q pillar microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have fabricated high-Q pillar resonators with colloidal CdSe/ZnS quantum dots or rods as light emitters by focused ion beam milling. Cavities with elliptical cross section show higher Q-values compared to circular resonators.

articleTitle: Absolute surface displacement measurement using pulsed photo-electromotive-force laser vibrometer
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally a new technique for measuring unambiguously the surface displacement of a vibrating surface using a high sensitivity pulsed laser vibrometer based on the photo-electromotive-force (photo-EMF) sensors. By intentionally introducing a reference vibration with known frequency and amplitude, we show that the photo-EMF pulsed laser vibrometer is able to determine the absolute value of surface displacement independent of the test subject's surface quality and the amount of laser power density impinging on the sensor.

articleTitle: Extending S-band of EDFA to 1450 nm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that it is possible to extend the operation of an erbium doped fiber amplifier to amplify in the conventionally inaccessible wavelength band of (1450-1480) nm, with >20 dB gain using reasonable pump power.

articleTitle: Terahertz electric polarizability of multiple excitons in CdSe quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dependence of the polarizability of a QD on the number of excitons in it was investigated. A simple model of weakly interacting charge carriers in an infinite spherical potential well agrees well with the experiment.

articleTitle: The influence of granularity on the subwavelength performance of a negative refractive index lens
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A model for a discrete negative refractive index slab lens is used to evaluate the impact of granularity on image resolution, in particular, on the evanescent eld transfer function.

articleTitle: Quantum imaging with incoherent photons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a technique to obtain sub-wavelength resolution in imaging with 100% visibility using incoherent light. We can in principle obtain a resolution of λ/N using coincidence detection of N photons emitted from N excited atoms.

articleTitle: All-optical bistable switching in a metal-dielectric multilayer structure due to intensity-dependent sign of the effective dielectric constant
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We numerically study light propagation through a nonlinear metal-dielectric multilayer structure, and predict all-optical bistable switching due to change of the effective dielectric constant from negative (low-transmission state) to positive (high-transmission state) values.

articleTitle: Exciton-polaritons at room temperature in dielectric microcavities exhibiting rabi-splitting ΩR ≫ 100 meV
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Exciton-Polariton states are observed at room temperature in planar sputter-coated dielectric microcavities containing 5 nm thick film of J-aggregated dye as excitonic layer exhibiting Rabi-splitting Ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</sub> ≫ 100meV and empty cavity Q factor ≫> 700.

articleTitle: Intersubband transition of AlN/GaN quantum wells in optimized AlN-based waveguide structure
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We achieved low-power saturation of intersubband absorption at 1.5 μm with AlN-based AlN/GaN quantum wells. By optimizing the etching condition of waveguides, the saturation energy was reduced by a factor of 3.

articleTitle: Far-field control of the radiative lifetime of an individual optical nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a scanning metallic probe we demonstrate the first long-range control of the radiative lifetime of an optical nanocavity resonant near 1.5 microns. Changes in lifetime are observed for probe-cavity separations up to 70 microns.

articleTitle: Detection of bacillus thuringiensis spore germination via CaDPA biomarker using laser tweezers raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report real-time observation of nutrient-trigged germination process of single Bacillus thuringiensis spores by detection of CaDPA biomarker using laser tweezers Raman spectroscopy. The time-to-germination was heterogeneous for spores and the distribution was measured.

articleTitle: Light grating storage
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light grating storage and retrieval is reported in cold cesium atoms employing non-collinear beam configuration. The stored grating is retrieved in the forward and backward directions after a controllable storage time up to 4 μs.

articleTitle: Chiral Photonic Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate novel chiral photonic metamaterials consisting of physically separated mutually twisted planar metal patterns in parallel planes. Such metamaterials are shown to exhibit very strong gyrotropy (600°/mm) in the visible, near-IR and microwaves.

articleTitle: Compensation of loss in propagating surface plasmon by optical gain
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ~30% elongation of the surface plasmon propagation length and show that the full compensation of the surface plasmon loss by optical gain is within the reach.

articleTitle: Femtosecond opto-magnetism
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that circularly polarized laser pulses may selectively excite different modes of magnetic resonance, realize quantum control of magnons, trigger magnetic phase transitions and switch spins in a controllable way on a subpicosecond timescale.

articleTitle: Nd3+:(La1-x,Bax)F3-x as vacuum ultraviolet scintillator and new laser material
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:(La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>,Ba<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>)F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-x</sub> as new scintillator and laser material is explored using efficient micro-PD method. Fluorescence peak located at 175 nm is better compared to Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:LaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> due to broader fluorescence and shorter VUV transmission edge.

articleTitle: Anti-Stokes Raman scattering of photoluminescence phonon replica in gan heterostructures: An effective technique for Probing Hot Phonons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed anti-Stokes Raman scattering of photoluminescence phonon replica in GaN heterostructures by non-equilibrium longitudinal-optical phonons. We demonstrate that such a process can be used to monitor the distribution of hot longitudinal-optical phonons.

articleTitle: Strong light extinction by a single molecule
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present cryogenic experiments where the direct signature of a single molecule on an incident laser beam is demonstrated. Strong extinction larger than 10% is achieved in near and farfield geometries.

articleTitle: Laser micro-processing for industrial production applications
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The advantages of laser micro-processing in device manufacture for the Solar, Displays and Microsystems industries have lead to the replacement of conventional manufacturing techniques in production environments. Tool advances and industrial production techniques will be discussed.

articleTitle: Phase detection based surface plasmon resonance biosensor in infrared with increased sensitivity and dynamic range
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method of phase-detection in the infrared is proposed to enhance the sensitivity and dynamic range of a single-wavelength Surface Plasmon Resonance biosensor. A structure is also proposed to prevent the sensitivity degradation.

articleTitle: Bigger and better: the critical role of self-phase modulation in ultraprecise optical frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self-phase modulation (SPM) is crucial to the production and expansion of optical frequency combs based on mode-locked lasers. I will review how SPM makes bigger and better frequency combs and discuss some of their applications.

articleTitle: Chemical and biological warfare agent and explosives detection based on femtosecond pulse-shaping technology
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Breakthrough technology in remote femtosecond pulse characterization and accurate delivery of ultrashort shaped pulses to distances greater than 30 meters is being used to develop remote detection of explosives as well as biological warfare agents.

articleTitle: Kerr-induced phase noise in quantum parity gates
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum parity gates that use weak nonlinearity between single photons and intense coherent pulses are analyzed using a continuous-time model for cross-phase modulation. An inevitable phase noise is shown to degrade gate fidelity.

articleTitle: Efficient terahertz generation from nanolayers to microlayers of InN
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Efficient terahertz pulses have been generated based on resonant optical rectification using sub-picosecond laser pulses at 790 nm from nanolayers to microlayers of InN with the layer thicknesses in the range of 25-1270 nm.

articleTitle: Using high-order harmonics with momentum imaging techniques to study atomic and molecular dynamics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use high harmonics in conjunction with coincidence momentum imaging (COLTRIMS) techniques to study simple molecules like CO, CO2 and N2. We explore the dynamics near the double ionization threshold using EUV/IR pump/probe techniques.

articleTitle: Optical-pump-THz-probe studies of carrier dynamics in Hg-based high-temperature superconducting thin films
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report time-resolved carrier dynamics in Hg-Ba-Ca-Cu-O high-temperature superconductors using optical excitation and THz probe femtosecond spectroscopy. Picosecond quasiparticle dynamics observed in our experiments suggests that Hg-based materials are attractive candidates for high-speed photodetectors.

articleTitle: Non-evanescently pumped raman silicon lasers using spiral-shaped microdisks
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose non-evanescently pumped Raman silicon lasers using spiral-shaped microdisks. Our simulations suggest that pump lightwave can be seamlessly butt-coupled at the spiral notch, whereas the Stokes lightwave can be out-coupled either evanescently or nonevanescently.

articleTitle: High density FTTH network utilizing asymmetric data transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A WDM-PON recycling incoming light to transmit upload stream has been proposed. Effect of Rayleigh scattering and uneven energy distribution are evaluated to achieve >60km bidirectional communication carrying 10Gb/s download and >300Mb/s upload data traffic.

articleTitle: Exciton dressing and capture by a photonic band edge
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate electromagnetically-induced anomalous quantum dynamics of an exciton in a photonic band gap quantum well heterostructure. The exciton can be captured in k -space by emission and re-absorption of virtual photons near a photonic band edge, lowering its energy by 1-10meV and its effective mass by 4-5 orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Silicon depletion-type microdisk electro-optic modulators using selectively integrated Schottky diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a design and analysis of silicon depletion-type microdisk electro-optic modulator with selectively integrated Schottky diodes. Our analysis suggests that the bandwidth is limited by the cavity lifetime rather than by the electrical performance.

articleTitle: Quantum-dot-photon dynamics in a coupled-cavity waveguide: a platform for bandedge quantum optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examine the strong-coupling quantum-dot-photon dynamics at the bandedge of a realistic, lossy, coupled-cavity waveguide and show that the signatures of bandedge coupling and Rabi oscillations are transmitted down the waveguide.

articleTitle: Single-contact multi-spatial-mode mode-locking Fabry-Perot semiconductor laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A time-domain analysis of single-contact multi-spatial-mode mode-locking semiconductor lasers is presented with simplified treatments of material gain that captures the picoseconds laser dynamics. The equivalent saturable absorption is shown resulting from the active multi-spatial-mode coupling.

articleTitle: Effect of surface plasmon polaritons on optical activity in chiral metal nanogratings
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A relation between the optical activity and the coupling of SPP modes localized at the different interfaces of a chiral nanograting is obtained from the dependence of the polarization rotation on the angle of incidence.

articleTitle: Laser-induced surface nano-ripples as manifestation of wigner excitons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a physical model of recently discovered sub-wavelength nano-ripples formed by fs pulses on solid-state surfaces. It predicts surface nano-stratification on the scale of a few tens of nanometers due to dipole-dipole electron interaction.

articleTitle: Axis and ring mode switching in multi-electrode GaAs quasi-stadium laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated and tested multi-electrode quasi-stadium laser diodes having GaAs/AlGaAs GRIN-SCH-SQW structures. Axis and ring mode switching was achieved under CW operation for output powers up to 15 mW by selecting the electrode used.

articleTitle: Photon emission statistics and coherence properties of high-ß semiconductor microcavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Complementary first- and second-order correlation experiments on high-ß micropillar lasers are presented, which trace a smooth transition from spontaneous to stimulated emission. Our observations accord with refined theoretical calculations on semiconductor microlaser emission characteristics.

articleTitle: Quantum telecommunication with atoms and photons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For long distances direct quantum communication via optical fiber is not viable, due to fiber losses. We will outline our program on the use of atomic ensembles for long distance quantum networks.

articleTitle: Optical studies of individual single-walled carbon nanotubes under axial strain
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effect of axial strain on individual single-walled carbon nanotubes has been investigated experimentally. Changes in the optical transition energies reflect both the nature of the transition being probed and crystallographic structure of the nanotube.

articleTitle: The fabrication of laser array by holographic interference lithography
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a novel method to produce different grating periods in one chip and applied this in the fabrication for laser array. The result shows accurate controllability of lasing wavelength and low threshold currents.

articleTitle: Transmission through composite nano aperture and effects of surface plasmon resonance
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Utilizing the characteristics of surface plasmon polariton effect[1][2], we proposed a new design of metallic nano-aperture which exhibits higher power through-put (at 1.40×) and similar spot size (110×129 nm2), in comparison with the proposed optimal performance of a C-aperture[3]

articleTitle: Microjoule supercontinuum generation by prechirped laser pulses in a large-mode-area photonic-crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A photonic-crystal fiber with a mode area of 3 80 µm2 transforms an amplified prechirped output of a femtosecond Cr: forsterite laser into supercontinuum radiation with a spectrum spanning from 700 to 1800 inn and a total energy of 1.15 µJ.

articleTitle: Polarization-dependence of ultrafast optical nonlinearities of Bragg-spaced quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic theory for the polarization dependence of the nonlinear reflection of Bragg-spaced quantum wells. Our theory includes polariton correlations beyond third order. Comparisons with experimental results show reasonably good agreement.

articleTitle: Multi-THz conductivity and lattice dynamics during a femtosecond insulator-metal transition in VO2
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrabroadband THz spectroscopy directly monitors the femtosecond onset of conductivity during the photoinduced insulator-to-metal phase transition in vanadium dioxide. We observe coherent structural distortions via anharmonic phonon coupling and fluence-dependent self-trapping of excitons.

articleTitle: Broadband, low intensity noise source for optical coherence tomography at 1.8μm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a fibre-system, based on CW Er-ASE-source-pumped highly nonlinear fibre. As low as -l20dBc/Hz intensity noise of the near-Gaussian ≫200nm bandwidth was obtained. The source can enable micron-scale OCT around low-scatter 1.8μm region.

articleTitle: Incoherent solitons in fast and local nonlinear media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict randomly fragmented coherent breathers and partially-coherent spatial solitons in instantaneous and local (e.g. Kerr) nonlinear media.

articleTitle: Doubly negative metamaterials with subwavelength unit cells in visible and near infrared
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A doubly negative metamaterial that can be tuned to operate in the visible and near infrared spectra, comprises deeply subwavelength periodic unit cells, and can be manufactured easily is presented. The underlying physics is elucidated.

articleTitle: Giant magnetoelastic effect in multiferroic Ba0.6Sr1.4Zn2Fe12O22
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a giant magnetoelastic effect in multiferroic Ba0.6Sr1.4Zn2Fe12O22 measured by ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. Coherent phonon excitation allows to measure the field- induced changes in the speed of sound and the corresponding elastic stiffness.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of inflection-point slow light modes in photonic crystal coupled waveguides
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the time-domain measurement of inflection-point slow light modes in a photonic crystal coupled waveguide. The S type band structure for the waveguide mode allows a unique opportunity for slow light measurement.

articleTitle: Investigating charge carrier mobilities in nanocrystal-polymer hybrid photovoltaic devices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the properties of charge separation and photo-carrier transport in P3HT/PbSe composites by employing ToF method under selective excitation conditions to study the ligand-effect on the photocarrier-trapping kinetics at the P3HT/PbSe interfaces.

articleTitle: Pulse-induced mutual coherence of the self-assembled quantum dots photoluminescence
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments show that a quantum dots ensemble's emission is partially mutually coherent under a laser excitation pulses with duration shorter than 600 fs. A possible pulse induced coherent superradiance predicted by Dicke is discussed.

articleTitle: Raman scattering from individual, isolated metallic carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have obtained Raman spectra of the high-energy (G) modes from individual metallic carbon nanotubes. The Raman lines are broadened to widths up to 100 cm,<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, indicating strong phonon damping by electron-hole pairs.

articleTitle: CdSe quantum dots in single plasmonic nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A silver-wire nanocavity with CdSe quantum dots (QD) is optimized towards cavity-QED by varying cavity length and QD-wire distance. QD-plasmon coupling, enhancement of spontaneous emission and group velocities in the nanocavity of vG~0.5c are observed.

articleTitle: A mid-IR DIAL system using interband cascade laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact, portable mid-IR differential absorption lidar system was built using Interband Cascade Lasers operating at 3.38 μm and 3.54 μm and its operation was demonstrated by measuring absorption of vapor phase ethanol.

articleTitle: In-situ probing of coherence in hollow waveguide high order harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use counterpropagating light to observe the coherent buildup of harmonic generation in a hollow waveguide. By measuring the phase mismatch, we probe pressure-tuned phase matching and determine ionization levels at which harmonics are generated.

articleTitle: Compact, high performance femtosecond laser ablation system for trace element analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a compact, industrial laser ablation system for trace element analysis. The system uses a high repetition rate femtosecond laser for material ablation and an inductively coupled mass spectrometer for analysis.

articleTitle: Simple experimental generation of a four-photon cluster state and distinguishing classes of genuine four-qubit entanglement using witness operators
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a simple scheme for generating a four-photon cluster state. We show that the produced state has genuine four-qubit entanglement which is discriminated from a class including GHZ and W types of entanglement.

articleTitle: In-situ pulse characterization for silicon micromachining
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond pulse characterization and adaptive pulse compression is demonstrated using surface second harmonic generation from a silicon wafer using multiphoton intrapulse interference phase scan (MIIPS).

articleTitle: Stable long-cavity regenerative amplifier with 10-11 ASE contrast
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Design and measurements of a high-contrast millijoule regenerative amplifier are presented. Coupled with a preamplifier and saturable absorber, the amplifier and subsequent compressor produce 3.7 mJ, 33 fs pulses with nanosecond ASE contrast of 10-11

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a terahertz negative permeability metamaterial with connected metallic discs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A negative permeability metamaterial is designed with 2 connected metallic discs inside a unit cell. It can be fabricated through thin-film processes. A negative permeability at ~1 THz is shown in the simulation result.

articleTitle: Measurement of transient susceptibility tensor created by rotational wave packets excited by arbitrarily polarized femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transient susceptibility tensors produced by rotational wavepackets formed by femtosecond laser pulses with arbitrary polarization are shown to be biaxial or uniaxial. Single-shot measurements of the phase modulation of a probe pulse are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Overview and recent topics in industrial laser applications in Japan
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents overview on trends of domestic production of laser materials processing equipment and introduces some recently achieved technological advances in industrial laser applications in Japan with a slightly emphasis on micro-processing applications.

articleTitle: Effective optical response of noble metal nanoparticle arrays and photonic crystals with embedded nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We numerically extract the effective optical constants of noble metal nanoparticle arrays and use them to study photonic crystals with embedded nanaparticles. We find sharp resonant features such as absorption doubling per nanometer wavelength.

articleTitle: Spiral-shaped microdisk resonator channel drop/add filters: Asymmetry in modal distributions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report experiments and simulations of spiral-shaped microdisk resonator channel drop/add filters with a non-evanescently-coupled waveguide at the spiral notch. We observe asymmetry in modal distributions between the drop/add filters at the same resonance wavelengths.

articleTitle: Depolarization of external optical feedback on VCSEL and variation of relative intensity noise
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By using of optical depolarizer, polarization dependence of external optical feedback on VCSEL is drastically reduced. Relative intensity noise and transmission characteristics of VCSEL are experimentally investigated under various polarization states of external optical feedback.

articleTitle: Molecular control of the evolution of capillary-generated soft X-ray high harmonics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonic generation from targets of Ar, N2 and N2O in a gas-filled capillary has been studied. A clear shift in the weighting of the harmonic intensity distribution with decreasing ionization energy is reported.

articleTitle: Coherent association of two-component atomic condensate into heteronuclear molecular condensate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the dynamics of associating a two-component atomic condensate into a condensate of heteronuclear molecules. We compare the mean-field results with a full quantum mechanical treatment, emphasizing the effects of atomic population imbalance.

articleTitle: Internal second harmonics of an injection-locked laser diode and its application to laser frequency stabilization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Features of internal second harmonics (ISH) originated from a laser diode injection-locked by a distribution feedback laser were experimentally observed. As an application of this injection-locked ISH, its frequency was locked to rubidium D2 line.

articleTitle: Biphoton in a two-level cooled atomic ensemble
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The temporal correlation of biphotons, generated from a two-level cooled atomic system, displays a photon anti-bunching effect, which corresponds to the interference between two types of nonlinear four-wave mixing processes occurring in such a medium.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral linewidth of al-free active region DFB laser diodes operating at 852nm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed single frequency and single spatial mode laser structures with stable narrow linewidth (<1MHz) and high optical power (40mW), using an aluminium free active region for Cs pumping at 852nm.

articleTitle: Fast intraband capture and relaxation in InAs/GaAs self-assembled quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electron capture and relaxation processes in n-type InAs/GaAs quantum dots were investigated using mid-infrared degenerated pump-probe spectroscopy. Fast (~4-10ps) intraband relaxation/capture times were measured even in the absence of electron-hole scattering.

articleTitle: Photodarkening and photobleaching of an Ytterbium-doped Silica Double-clad LMA fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied the temporal behaviour of photodarkening in an Yb-doped LMA fiber and show photobleaching of the same fiber. The absorption spectra and the influence on the lasing properties are shown.

articleTitle: An offset-apertured probe: A hybrid apertured and scattering-type near-field scanning optical probe
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the results of simulations performed to characterize the influence of various factors on energy throughput and resolution of a NSOM tip having a subwavelength aperture offset from the apex.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth diode laser system for coherent precision spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new type of diode laser system for precision spectroscopy is presented. Its excellent passive stability eases locking to fs-frequency combs, which is demonstrated with high resolution spectroscopy of cold HD+ ions.

articleTitle: Stimulated polariton scattering in intersubband lasers - role of motional narrowing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a theory of polariton scattering in the inhomogeneously broadened intersubband transitions and have shown that motional narrowing plays important role. This explains abnormally high gain of the experimentally observed parametric process

articleTitle: Cancer detection using infrared transillumination
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The viability of a new infrared imaging modality for the detection of breast cancer is tested via whole animal imaging studies. The potential of this technique for imaging human breast tissue is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Parametric frequency conversion of optical simulton pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an analytical description of the parametric frequency conversion of short solitary wave optical pulses in quadratic nonlinear crystals controlled by means of a continuous wave background.

articleTitle: Phonon-induced dephasing of optical spin control in single-charged quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Within a density-matrix approach, we study the phonon-induced decoherence effects on the nonlinear dynamics and pump-probe spectra for the optical control of a spin in a single-charged quantum dot proposed recently.

articleTitle: Quantum entanglement and metrology
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For linear couplings of N systems to a parameter, quantum entanglement can improve the precision of parameter estimation from the 1/√N shot-noise limit to the 1/N Heisenberg limit. Intrinsic k-body couplings improve this scaling further to 1/N>sup>k.

articleTitle: Single-shot two-photon action cross section measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a one-shot approach for measuring two-photon action cross section without tuning the excitation wavelength. The results obtained by this method show good agreement with that obtained by conventional methods using tunable lasers.

articleTitle: Simulation of the propagation of a UV filament in the air.
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present two simplified models for the propagation of a long pulse UV filament in air, predicting the evolution of the beam diameter with distance, and the beam profile.

articleTitle: Visible 2-dimentional photonic crystal laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Visible 2-dimentional photonic crystal lasers were fabricated within membranes of InGaP/InGaAlP quantum well material emitting around 670nm. These red photonic crystal lasers with ultra-small mode volumes (~ 0.01 μm3) are ideally useful for spectroscopic sources.

articleTitle: Evidence of periodic electric fields generated by Spatial separation of photogenerated electron-hole pairs in short-period InAs/GaSb type-II superlattices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Under relatively high pump intensities, photoluminescence intensities across the miniband were greatly reduced, which was attributed to the existence of periodic electric fields caused by spatially-separated photogenerated electrons and holes in short-period type-II InAs/GaSb superlattices.

articleTitle: Probing proton dynamics in molecules on an attosecond timescale
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A technique for probing ultrafast (attosecond) structural rearrangement in molecules following laser ionization is discussed. The temporal window accessible has recently been extended beyond that previously reported by employing a driving field in the mid-IR.

articleTitle: Dispersive, superfluid-like shock waves in nonlinear optics: Properties & interactions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate dispersive optical shock waves in ID and 21), characterize their nonlinear properties, and observe the complex interactions when two such shocks collide.

articleTitle: Density tuning of one-dimensional electron gas in a T-shaped quantum wire
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Variable-density one-dimensional electron gas was realized in a T-shaped quantum wire with an FET gate. We achieved photoluminescence-excitation measurements on a single wire and observed spectral evolution from degenerate to non-degenerate one-dimensional electron gas.

articleTitle: Spatial selection of atoms in optical billiard
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By releasing ultra-cold atoms from a small red detuned Gaussian trap to an optical wedge billiard we reduce the energy broadening of the atoms and perform spatial selection on the initial occupied phase space.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse electric-field reconstruction using only one autocorrelator
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Full-field reconstruction of ultrashort laser pulses can be obtained using Modifiedspectrum auto-interferometric correlation (MOSAIC) traces and the pulse spectrum. This technique is implemented using only a single interferometric autocorrelator.

articleTitle: Wideband to narrowband pulse shaping via a chirp-transform scaling technique
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a chirp-transform scaling technique to increase the spectral resolution of a pulse shaper by three orders of magnitude. Using this technique quasi-monochromatic pulses at 532nm are shaped on a picosecond time-scale.

articleTitle: Highspeed production of periodical nanostructures using femtosecond laser radiation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ripples (spacing <λ/4) are obtained by scanning femtosecond laser radiation (τ=100fs & 400fs. λ=800nm & 1045nm) over the surface of various materials. The ripple patterns extend coherently over many overlapping laser pulses and scanning tracks.

articleTitle: Slow propagation, anomalous absorption, and total external reflection of surface plasmon polaritons in nanolayer systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict that a nanoscopic, high-permittivity layer on the surface of a plasmonic metal can cause total external reflection of surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs). Such a layer can be used as a mirror in nanoplasmonics, in particular for resonators of nanolasers and spasers and also can be used in adiabatic nanooptics. We also show that the earlier predicted slow propagating SPP modes, especially those with negative refraction, are highly damped.

articleTitle: Gain grating in a Nd:YVO4 microlaser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intracavity gain gratings are theoretically demonstrated to exhibit diffraction efficiencies larger than unity at pumping powers below lasing threshold. Experiments performed using a Nd- YVO4 microlaser demonstrate huge enhancements of diffraction efficiency and angular selectivity.

articleTitle: Tip-to-sample distance control in apertureless near-field optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel mode of AFM operation is proposed providing the small, few nanometers tip to sample gap, appropriate for the ANSOM experiments. A set-up open for the run-time adjustments, working at ambient conditions is considered.

articleTitle: Wave kinetic instabilities in nonlinear, statistical optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate wave-kinetic instabilities in the nonlinear coupling of two partially-coherent beams. We report pure momentum-space energy transfer, without intensity modulations, below the (joint) MI threshold and full {x,k} phase space dynamics above it.

articleTitle: Proton acceleration from thin foils using ultraintense, high-contrast pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Proton production from ultrathin foils using 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> ASE contrast is explored. Maximum proton energy and laser transmittance for ultrathin foils are studied to achieve ion acceleration within the Directed Coulomb Explosion regime.

articleTitle: Combining of modes of broad-area laser diode into a single-mode spot
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multi-mode laser diode emission is reshaped into single-mode circular spot with the help of grating spectrometer and amplitude/phase spatial modulator. Paper investigates optical design and shows preliminary results on lateral modes combining.

articleTitle: Pulsewidth dependent nonlinear absorption In Au Films
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Z-scans of 20 nm Au films at 630 nm show strong fluence and pulse-width dependence of nonlinear absorption that is characteristic of electron heating; ßeff increases > 100 × as pulse width increases hom 0.1 - 6 ps.

articleTitle: Design of non-magnetic optical cloak
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the design and analysis of a non-magnetic cloak operating at optical frequencies. The general recipe for the implementation of such a device is provided. The cloaking performance is illustrated with finite-element simulations.

articleTitle: Degenerate four-wave mixing mediated by ponderomotive-force-driven plasma gratings
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Degenerate four-wave mixing mediated by ponderomotive-force-driven plasma gratings is demonstrated in the near-infrared regime, which may be used to compensate for wavefront distortion occurring in various laser-plasma-based devices.

articleTitle: Structural dependence of optical gain and carrier losses in InGaN quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using fully microscopic models it is shown that piezoelectric fields in InGaN/GaN quantum well structures lead to complex structural dependencies of the optical gain and carrier losses resulting in non-trivial minima for the threshold current.

articleTitle: Optical control of electron spin precession in semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a spin manipulation scheme that controls the amplitude as well as the phase of the quantum beats from electron spin coherence by exploiting the relative phase between relevant Larmor precessions of electron spins.

articleTitle: Gain-assisted dispersion management in negative-index materials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that relatively weak material gain can be utilized as an effective tool to manipulate dispersion of negative index materials achieving, in particular, broadband impedance- or index-matching. Finite-size and unbounded media are discussed.

articleTitle: Absolute mode number determination using two er:fiber laser combs for optical frequency metrology
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We uniquely determine the mode number using two erbium-doped fiber laser combs operating in different repetition rates for optical frequency measurement with no dependence on the frequency fluctuation of the laser under measurement.

articleTitle: Optical amplification at 0.54µm by Er3+ -doped fluoride fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 16.5 dB all-fiber optical amplifier at 546 nm using Er3+ -doped fluoride fiber for -30 dBm signal power by forward upconversion pumping of a 974 nm laser diode with power of 225mW.

articleTitle: Subwavelength focusing of light without evanescent waves by an array of nanoholes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We provide the first evidence of free-space subwavelength focusing without evanescent fields using a photonic nano-structure. Hot-spots smaller than half of the wavelength were observed at distances of tens of wavelengths from the structure.

articleTitle: Low power optical bistability in 1550 nm VCSOAs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Clockwise and counterclockwise bistability are demonstrated in 1550 nm VCSOAs at input powers two orders of magnitude lower than previously. Butterfly bistability is also observed for the first time in VCSOAs.

articleTitle: Terahertz difference frequency generation in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate intra-cavity terahertz difference-frequency generation in quantum cascade lasers. A two-wavelength quantum cascade laser with monolithically integrated optical nonlinearity emitting at 7.6 and 8.7 μm was used to generate difference frequency at 62 μm.

articleTitle: Pulse compression by coherent raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The width of an ultraviolet pulse is compressed to sub-20 fs from 100 fs using a prism compressor by compensating the group delay dispersion among the Raman sidebands generated by coherent Raman scattering.

articleTitle: Multimode SCM-based PON architecture for computer network applications using a low-cost polymer 1×8 splitter/combiner
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A low-cost PON architecture based on sub-carrier multiplexing and an 8-way low loss multimode polymer splitter/combiner is presented operating at 850nm. Two-channel error-free operation with a Q-factor greater than 8 is observed.

articleTitle: "Photon emission by photon" model for spontaneous frequency conversion in dispersive dielectric microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We develop a quantum-field model for photon conversion in dispersive cavity, incorporating dispersion into spatial eigenmodes. Direct calculations of spontaneous photon-tophoton decay rates that cannot be done conventionally are reported.

articleTitle: Strong-coupling cavity QED with nitrogen vacancy centers and silica microspheres
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report experimental demonstration of strong-coupling in a cavity QED system, in which nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond nanocrystals are coupled to whispering gallery modes in a deformed silica microsphere.

articleTitle: Intense field ionization of methane, butane, and octane: Transition from molecular to atomic response
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ionization yields of C+n (n<6) from ionization of methane, butane, and octane are measured from 1013W/cm2 to 1016W/cm2. As one reaches 1016 W/cm2 the molecular response becomes atomic-like.

articleTitle: A tunable-bandwidth white light interferometer using Bi-frequency Raman gain in atomic vapor
