publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A White Light Cavity is of considerable interest in broadband gravitational-wave detection. This paper presents a demonstration of the such a system in a meter long ring-cavity using bi-frequency Raman gain in the intra-cavity medium.

articleTitle: Two-quantum-path interferences in high order harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have investigated intensity dependent high-harmonic generation, when short and long trajectories are both visible in the generated signal. We have measured a plateau-harmonic spectral broadening and yield modulations consistent with quantum-paths interferences calculations.

articleTitle: An ultra-dispersive optically controlled atomic prism
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated an ultra-dispersive atomic prism with the highest spectral angular dispersion ever shown (six orders of magnitude higher than glass prism). Its dispersion is optically controlled by a coherent driving field.

articleTitle: Fundamental physics and applications of whispering-gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

articleTitle: EIT with counter-propagating probe-coupling beams in acetylene-filled HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental results demonstrating for the first time to our knowledge the observation of electromagnetically-induced-transparency using a counter-propagating beam configuration in an acetylene filled hollow-core PCF gas-cell, in both V and Λ energy-level schemes.

articleTitle: H2S trace detection using off-axis integrated cavity Output Spectroscopy in the Near-Infrared
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: H2S trace detection has been performed by means of DFB diode laser-based off-axis integrated cavity output spectroscopy (OA-ICOS) near 1571.6 nm. A minimum detectable concentration of 700 ppb (3σ) was obtained.

articleTitle: Self-phase-modulation of optical beams- the formative years
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An overview will be presented covering early initial observations and interpretation of self-phase modulation in self-trapped filaments of light and mode-locked laser pulses, the subsequent evolution of the basic concepts, and various applications.

articleTitle: The Big Bang Observer: High laser power for gravitational wave astrophysics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Big Bang Observer(BBO) is a proposed space-based gravitational wave detector which will look for the stochastic background of gravitational waves from the early universe. The positions of three free test masses, 50,000 km apart, will be monitored by laser interferometry. To reduce noise, 300 W of 355 nm light obtained from frequency-tripling the output of Nd:YAG lasers will be used. These lasers and other technology necessary for BBO will require significant research before a potential launch date of 2025.

articleTitle: An optical fiber for brillouin-based discriminative sensing of strain and temperature
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single mode fiber with a highly GeO2-doped core and an F-doped inner-cladding is designed for Brillouin-based discriminative sensing of strain and temperature. The conditions to control high-order longitudinal acoustic modes are investigated.

articleTitle: Enhanced high harmonic generation in Xe, Kr and Ar using a capillary discharge
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a significant extension of the harmonic cutoff in xenon, krypton and argon ions using a capillary discharge, up to 160 eV, 170 eV and 275 eV respectively.

articleTitle: All-Fiber integrated assemblies based on the resonant tunneling effect in multi-core photonic band-gap fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of designing compact ultra-narrow band-pass filters to split four different wavelengths based on the phenomenon of non-proximity resonant tunneling in multi-core photonic band-gap fibers for resonance-sensing and wavelength-selective filtering applications.

articleTitle: Nd-vanadate thin-disk lasers under diode pumping into the 4F5/2 and 4F3/2 levels
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on continuous-wave 532-nm Nd:YVO4 thin-disk lasers with output powers of 6.4 W and 4.4 W with pumping at 808 nm and 880 nm, respectively. Also, deep-blue emission in the watt regime was achieved from Nd-doped vanadates.

articleTitle: Single water microdroplets resting on a superhydrophobic surface: Largely tunable optical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: More than 9 nm tunability of the whispering gallery modes of water microdroplets resting on a superhydrophobic surface is demonstrated. Tunability was achieved by introducing evaporation or condensation in microdroplets in a mini humidity chamber.

articleTitle: A fully bi-directional 2.4GHz wireless-over-fibre system using Photonic Active Integrated Antennas (PhAIAs)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Low cost Wireless-over-fibre system has been demonstrated over 300m of MMF. Throughput and SNR as a function of RF propagation distance are shown and successful streaming of video is achieved over a 10m range.

articleTitle: Second Harmonic Generation in AlGaAs/AlOx Random Structures.
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Summary form only given. Our aim is to study the nonlinear properties of micro-structured devices, and focus on second harmonic generation in random dielectric structures. We recently proposed[2006] a new method to achieves highly efficient second harmonic generation in random structures. This method does not rely on phase matching, is insensitive to fabrication tolerances, and it provides excellent tunability in both incident angle and wavelength. While overall performance maybe not as high as in high-Q, doubly-resonant devices, yet we find an enha ncement factor that is four orders of magnitude larger than what can be obtained from an unprocessed, nonlinear material, and in excess of one order of magnitude with respect to an ideally phase-matched, nonlinear material. We applied our theoretical results to design, realize and experimentally test a sample made of AlGaAs/AlOx layers grown in a GaAs substrate.

articleTitle: Coherent phonons imprinted into reflectivity oscillations of laser-excited Bi through electron-phonon coupling
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the reflectivity of laser-excited solid relates to phonons, driven by thermal forces, through the electron-phonon coupling rate. Controlled excitation of phonons is available by the optimum combination of laser and material parameters.

articleTitle: Sub-clock extraction of optical signals at high rates using an opto-electronic phase-locked loop based on three-wave mixing in periodically-poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-clock extraction and clock synchronization of signals, at rates of 30 GHz and 10 Gbps, by an opto-electronic phase-locked loop based on three-wave mixing in periodically-poled lithium niobate, are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Tunable single-to-single and single-to-dual channel wavelength conversions of Ps-Pulses using PPLN-based double-ring fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel scheme of tunable single-to-single and single-to-dual channel wavelength conversions using a double-ring fiber laser incorporating a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide. No external pump and control sources are required.

articleTitle: Multipolar interference in second-order responses of gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that higher multipole radiation constitutes up to 20% of the total second-harmonic field amplitude emitted by an array of gold nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Image inversion and magnification by negative index prisms
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Prism structures with negative index materials were investigated for their novel focusing properties such as image inversion and magnification. They reinforce the functions of flat lens and broaden the applications of negative index materials.

articleTitle: Power dissipation requirements in slow light devices
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Various slow ligh schemes are analyzed to determine power dissipation per stored bit. It is shown that required dissipated power increases quite nonlinearly reaching unsustainably high values for the storage capacities needed for optical buffers.

articleTitle: Detailed comparison of injection-seeded and self-seeded performance of a gain-switched laser diode
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the performance of a gain-switched picosecond laser diode operating at 1.06 μm when either injection- or self- seeded. We conclude that the much simpler self-seeding arrangement leads to no degradation of performance.

articleTitle: Few-cycle optical bullets with stable carrier-envelope phase in a two-component medium
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how such backbone notions as carrier, envelope, phase and group velocities can be extended beyond the SVEA approximation A two-cycle pulse is able to evolve into an optical bullet with stable carrier-envelope phase.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic voltage sensor using a hybrid laser interferometer
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A hybrid interferometer, a Michelson and a Mach-Zehnder combined, is proposed to demodulate a fiber-optic voltage sensor. By using quadrature sampling with internal triggers, optical path difference can be obtained and translated into voltage output.

articleTitle: Beam characteristics of mid-IR quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report divergence, astigmatism and M2 measurements for 8.77gm quantum cascade lasers. Measurements showed divergence of 62° by 32° FWHM f 2° and M2 values of 1.81 and 1.22 for the fast and slow axes respectively. Astigmatism at source was ~4gm, less than half a wave.

articleTitle: All-optical switching at ultra-low light levels
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experimental demonstration of all-optical switching with the signal and control light pulses containing about 20 photons each, corresponding to a control energy density of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> photons per atomic cross section λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/(2π).

articleTitle: Magnetic plasmon resonances and optical activity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel type of optical activity due to magnetic plasmon resonances is demonstrated for a first time. A linearly polarized light is shown to change polarization after passing through a metamaterial made of coupled magnetic dimers.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation using imaging taper
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate supercontinuum generation from a Schott imaging fiber taper. Supercontinua simultaneously generated from two fibers of an imaging taper were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Add-drop filters based on mode conversion cavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A resonator defined by mode-converting gratings in a waveguide is proposed This resonator can exhibit narrow resonances similar to Fabry-Perot with an advantage of being a four-port device capable of serving as an add-drop filter.

articleTitle: Light emitting diodes with extremely high extraction-efficiency for electroluminescence refrigeration
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: InGaAs light emitting diodes with extremely high light extraction efficiency are fabricated by monolithically integrating the light emitting region with a suspended GaAs hemispherical lens. This design is being developed for electroluminescence refrigeration applications.

articleTitle: Microcavities using holey fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microcavities have been formed by placing mirrors on the ends of a short section of holey fiber. These microcavities may be useful for enhancing nonlinear effects at single-photon intensities.

articleTitle: Turn-on dynamics of semiconductor quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical approach including Coulomb scattering to InAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers. In agreement with experiments we find strongly damped relaxation oscillations. We show the crucial importance of Coulomb interaction for this characteristic feature.

articleTitle: Mode control by lattice deforming in InGaAsP/InP photonic crystal laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dipole mode in point defect photonic crystal shows the characteristics of nondegenerate by deforming lattice structure. Lasing action with single mode, y-mode, is obtained in the elongated point defect cavity in our experiment.

articleTitle: Negative index metamaterial for two distinct polarizations: Double negative at 813 nm and single negative at 770 nm
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A negative index metamaterial demonstrating n=-1.0+0.8i with both negative effective permittivity and permeability at 813 nm of linearly polarized light is fabricated. It also exhibits a negative refractive index at 770 nm for orthogonal polarization.

articleTitle: An atomic clock based on a VCSEL-driven CPT resonance and a small 87Rb vapor cell
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a high performance frequency standard based on Coherent Population Trapping, incited by a modulated VCSEL in the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb-D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> line. Short-term stabilities of σy=3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup>/√τ and relative frequency deviations below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup>/day were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Percolation of light in 3D lattices of coupled microspheres
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The propagation of light in systems of disordered coupled cavities with whispering gallery resonances is interpreted in terms of percolation theory. The existence of well connected clusters is demonstrated in scattering spectra of such lattices.

articleTitle: 100X enhancement of the nonlinear refractive index of sulfur-doped CS2 over pure CS2
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Preliminary Z-scan measurements of variable concentration sulfur-doped CS2 indicate a twoorder of magnitude enhancement of the nonlinear index (n2) over CS2. The laser repetition rate will be varied to determine any thermal contribution to n2.

articleTitle: Numerical simulations of the ultrasimple ultrashort-laser-pulse measurement technique, GRENOUILLE
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Our simulations show that accurate GRENOUILLE measurements are easily obtained. The FROG algorithm further improves performance because it "sees through" distortions. We also obtain GRENOUILLE's spectral response, allowing spectral deconvolution for even better performance.

articleTitle: Asymmetrical M2 in solid state laser beam shaping for the line scanning laser annealing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new type of beam shaping system in combination with special characterization of laser parameters provides several mm depth of focus by narrow width and very good homogenization of the line-shaped laser intensity distribution for scanning annealing.

articleTitle: Multi-species trace gas detection by rapidly swept cavity ringdown spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A cavity ringdown spectrometer, based on a rapidly swept optical cavity and multiple-wavelength coherent radiation, detects several gas-phase molecules simultaneously. This comprises a compact, high-performance instrument for efficient spectroscopic sensing of gases.

articleTitle: Cross-Phase modulation in AlGaAs photonic nanowires
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cross-Phase modulation (XPM) is investigated in AlGaAs nanowires by way of cross-polarized co-propagating pulses. A XPM to SPM (Self-Phase Modulation) ratio of 0.92 is determined at 1557 nm.

articleTitle: Two mechanisms of high harmonic generation from overdense laser plasmas - relativistic and non-relativistic
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonics from ultra-intense laser-matter interaction can be generated by both linear means and by relativistic means. In experiments up to a few 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> Wcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2,</sup> we show the distinctions and means to control each.

articleTitle: Radiation-pressure effects upon a micro-mirror in a high-finesse optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an experiment where the motion of a micro-mechanical resonator is optically monitored with a quantum-limited sensitivity. Directs effects of intracavity radiation pressure are experimentally demonstrated. Applications to quantum optics are discussed.

articleTitle: Laser-assisted photoemission from surfaces
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using femtosecond time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy, we present experimental measurements that distinguish the laser-assisted photoelectric effect from other inherent surface processes, such as above threshold photoemission, space-charge acceleration and hot electron excitation.

articleTitle: High-visibility classical multi-photon interference
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-visibility multi-photon interference is usually considered as a signature of nonclassical light. We show, theoretically and experimentally, that three-photon interference visibility can be as high as 81.8% for coherent light and 60% for thermal light.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental study of third order difference frequency generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed several experimental validations of a model based on Jacobi elliptic functions describing collinear phase-matched Third Order Difference Frequency Generation without spatial and temporal walk-off. The experiments used KTP crystals and sub-nanosecond laser beams.

articleTitle: Microring resonators using multiphoton absorption polymerization
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of polymer microring add-drop filters using multiphoton absorption polymerization and present the characterization of these devices.

articleTitle: Time-resolved third harmonic generation from laser- melted semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: To develop shock melting diagnostics, we are studying laser melted semiconductors using nonlinear optical probes. We find a rapid response in THG from Si and GaAs, with both linearly and circularly polarized incident radiation.

articleTitle: Fluorescent and photoconductive properties of anthradithiophene and pentacene derivatives
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present optical, fluorescent and photoconductive properties of high-performance anthradithiophene and functionalized pentacene derivatives. Fluorescence emission with lifetimes around or longer than ~10 ns is observed at visible and near-infrared wavelengths, depending on the molecule.

articleTitle: Ultrafast spin dynamics in manganese doped GaN
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We perform time-resolved Faraday rotation measurements on GaMnN. For the first time, we are able to deliberately excite and probe the "Mn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>+ + hole" complex in this material.

articleTitle: Initial dynamics of supercontinuum generation in highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We analyze supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fibers (PCF) composed of Schott-SF6 glass with experiments and simulation.We present for the first time the Raman response function of SF6 and validate theory with experimental data.

articleTitle: Emission characteristics of InGaN/GaN vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lasing characteristics of optically pumped GaN-based vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers were investigated. The laser emission showed single and multiple spots emission patterns with spectral and spatial variation under different pumping conditions.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of sub-threshold modes in vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate sub-threshold modes in single-mode vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSEL's). These modes produce beating in the emission of VCSEL's after femtosecond optical pulse injection. The results provide information on the stability of the single-mode regime.

articleTitle: Paradoxical features of monochromatic light amplification in multicore fibers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is numerically revealed and properly interpreted a phenomenon of predominant amplification of an optical mode with lower modal gain in 7-core fiber laser. Mode beating is a key factor responsible for this effect.

articleTitle: Negative meta-magnetism in the visible range
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Arrays of silver nano-strips reveal negative effective permeabilities of -1 and -1.7 at 770 nm and 725 nm. We show that lower silver deposition rate results in stronger magnetic resonances.

articleTitle: Filtered SOA de-multiplexer structure with pattern independence at 0.1 THz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the numerical analysis of the performances of a SOA-based architecture performing, with a simple optical filtering operation, the all-optical channel extraction from a 0.1THz, 1ps FWHM pulses sequence without any pattern-dependence.

articleTitle: Wavelength exchange with enhanced extinction ratio in highly nonlinear dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple approach to enhance the extinction ratio of wavelength exchange with a polarization-diversity technique. Over 25 dB of extinction ratio is attained with 6 dB improvement over that of the conventional configuration.

articleTitle: Matrices and necklaces of solitons in nonlocal nonlinear media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce novel classes of higher-order spatial optical solitons, analogous to Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) and Hermite-Gaussian (HG) linear eigenmodes, and demonstrate numerically that modulational instability can lead to nontrivial transformations between solitons of different symmetries.

articleTitle: Generation of quantum correlated photon pairs from a vertical triple microcavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the statistics of twin photons emitted by a vertical triple microcavity. We measured the intensity correlations of the signal and idler by measuring the noise spectra. Quantum correlated photon modes are observed.

articleTitle: Robustness enhancement of iteration-free spectral phase retrieval by interferometric second-harmonic trace
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically demonstrated a new multi-slice scheme that could suppress the noise-induced spectral phase error in measurement of electric field by interferometric spectral trace observation (MEFISTO) by eightfold or better without measuring additional data.

articleTitle: Modes of the L3 defect cavity in InAs quantum dot photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the longest wavelength modes of an L3 photonic crystal cavity. Reordering of modes due to hole displacement is shown theoretically and experimentally. Cavity optimization is explained in terms of dipolar emission cancellation.

articleTitle: Speckle mechanism in optical coherence imaging
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Relation between holographic speckle size and mean free path of milk is studied in a holographic OCI system. Results indicate that speckle size is linearly depends on the mean free path of the turbid media.

articleTitle: Optical field enhancement In tweezer trapping
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near-resonant light can be used to enhance optical trapping of particles with wavelength dependent optical responses. We present results from our study of optically enhanced forces acting on dielectric and metal nanoparticles in tweezers trapping.

articleTitle: Optical magnetism
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Magnetic dipole radiation one fourth as intense as electric dipole radiation, as well as a novel nonlinear magneto-optical effect are reported in dielectric media.

articleTitle: Magnifying superlens in the visible frequency range
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the experimental realization of a magnifying superlens working in the visible frequency range. Our design is based on a metal-dielectric plasmonic metamaterial, which consists of alternating positive and negative refractive index layers.

articleTitle: Measurement of optical forces within a high-Q microcavity-waveguide system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical forces arising from the intense stored field within a high-Q microdisk cavity are measured through the displacement of a moveable, micron-scale fiber taper input waveguide. Tunable waveguide-cavity coupling is demonstrated at sub-mW input powers.

articleTitle: Nondestructive internal device characterization of an oxide-confined vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A nondestructive method is presented to determine the internal properties of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers. The refractive index and oxide radius are extracted from the laser modes and agree well with independently determined values.

articleTitle: A high-intensity bowtie nano-aperture vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser for near-field optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a record-high-intensity bowtie nano-aperture vertical-cavity surfaceemitting laser (VCSEL) with near-field spot size of 65 nm. The bowtie aperture VCSEL is very promising to realize near-field applications such as ultradense optical data storage.

articleTitle: Evidence of many-body, fermi-energy edge singularity in InN films grown on GaN buffer layers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed the strong enhancement of photoluminescence intensities close to electron Fermi energy as the result of the breakdown of k-selection rule for radiaitive recombination due to the localization of holes in InN films.

articleTitle: Near-field imaging of the evanescent electric field on the surface of a quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation by scanning near-field optical microscopy of the evanescent electric field on the surface of a quantum cascade laser. The devices have been designed in order to let a consistent portion of its optical mode to leak out of the top surface. The laser wavelength in vacuum is ≈ 7.7 μm

articleTitle: Self-phase modulation in optical fiber communications: good or bad?
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self-phase modulation is often regarded as being harmful for optical communication systems. In this overview, I first discuss its impact on such systems and then focus on its useful applications related to all-optical signal processing, soliton formation, and optical regeneration.

articleTitle: High power EUVL source demonstration of tin-doped droplet laser plasma generated by industrial solid state lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High EUV source power has been demonstrated with a laser-plasma source exhibiting low debris and high conversion efficiency. This offers a viable path towards successful realization of EUV lithography for the next generation semiconductor devices.

articleTitle: Compact slit-less spectrometer using cylindrical beam volume holograms
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present compact slit-less spectrometers using cylindrical beam holograms with several advantages over conventional spectrometers. We demonstrate large spectral range spectrometers using spatially multiplexed cylindrical beam holograms without adding any moving part in spectroscopic systems.

articleTitle: Kerr nonlinearity induced optical frequency comb generation in microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is shown that the optical sidebands generated via optical parametric oscillations in a monolithic microcavity are equidistant thus overcoming the intrinsic cavity dispersion. This leads to the generation of optical frequency combs at input powers < 10 mW.

articleTitle: Detection of B. subtilis spores via hybrid CARS
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first observation of endospores via a new technique, hybrid CARS, which identifies the endospore marker molecules by simultaneous measurement of several vibrational modes. The scheme holds promise for remote/stand-of detection applications.

articleTitle: Fast spin state initialization of a single quantum dot electron
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the demonstration of fast spin state initialization with near unity efficiency in a singly-charged quantum dot by optically cooling an electron spin.

articleTitle: THz-wave fiber generator for 1-15THz band
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated ultra wideband terahertz (THz) transmission through inner silver- coated hollow fiber using widely tunable THz-wave generator. The inner diameter of 304mm long silver-coated hollow fiber was lmm. THz-wave transmission in 1-15THz was almost uniform.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of intense field ionization rates in sapphire and water during short pulse laser propagation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a pump-probe experiment that directly measures electron ionization rates via plasma-induced blue-shifting during filamentation of a short laser pulse. We compare to Keldysh and Thornber theory.

articleTitle: Observation of embedded lattice solitons
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of embedded lattice soliton trains. Such solitons arise from the X-symmetry points in the first Bloch band but still reside (embedded) in the first band of a 2D photonic lattice.

articleTitle: Inscription of optical waveguides with ultrafast Bessel beams
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical waveguides have been inscribed in fused silica by focusing femtosecond pulses with an axicon. The waveguides so fabricated exhibit low losses and no detectable birefringence due to their excellent circular symmetry.

articleTitle: Weak coupling interactions of silicon photonic crystals with lead sulphide nanocrystals at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate weak coupling interactions of silicon photonic crystals with PbS nanocrystals at room temperature. Coupling is verified through cold-cavity integrated waveguide measurements, with polarization extinction of 1.7 and emission enhancements that match simulations.

articleTitle: Elastic-light scattering for the characterization of respirable aerosols
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The latest technologies for measuring the elastic-light scattering patterns of respirable aerosols in real time are discussed. A technique for post-processing the data is presented which is useful in distinguishing among certain types of aerosols.

articleTitle: Probing photoconductivity in discotic liquid crystals by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical pump/terahertz probe spectroscopy was employed to investigate electronic charge transport in discotic liquid crystals. Frequency dependent complex conductivity was observed in phthalocyanines for a few hundred of picoseconds following a femtosecond photoexcitation.

articleTitle: 3D photofabrication by femtosecond laser pulses and its applications in photonics and biomedicine
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

articleTitle: Fluorescence enhancement by surface gratings.
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Enhancement of fluorescence from Rhodamine6G molecules near a dielectric grating deposited onto a gold film is observed. The enhancement mechanism is consistent with excitation of surface plasmon polaritons on the film surface.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a 486 nm single frequency source using an MgO:PPLN waveguide doubled semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 972 nm semiconductor butterfly laser is stabilized with a fiber grating to single frequency (600 mW) and doubled in a MgO:PPLN waveguide (90 mW) for evaluation as a simple laser source for precision spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Design of gradient index (GRIN) lens using photonic non-crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use analytical and numerical techniques to design a cylindrical lens with a gradient index of refraction. In our device, we design the desired index distribution by using a photonic crystal with slowly-varying lattice parameters.

articleTitle: Is entanglement dispensable in quantum lithography?
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Can classical light simulate the effect of quantum lithography? The analysis of the two-photon image generated both by entangled two-photon and by chaotic radiation indicates that only entanglement can double the resolution of an image.

articleTitle: Tunable polarization and power anti-Stokes line generation in birefringent photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By changing the polarization of less than 7fs input pulses that was coupled into the single mode birefringent photonic crystal fiber, we achieved both polarization and power modulation of the anti-stokes line simultaneously.

articleTitle: Multiple-beam collapse in Kerr media
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the spatial collapse dynamics of several coupled beams in Kerr media. Depending on the initial beam configuration, we observe sharp transitions to either fusion or annihilation of the collapsing beams.

articleTitle: Nanosecond to microsecond dynamics of 1040nm semiconductor disk lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the lasing dynamics of semiconductor disk lasers following well and barrier pumping with both 500ns and 5 μs pulses. The dynamics are explained using rate-equations.

articleTitle: Excitonic and semiconductor bloch equation approaches to carrier dvnamics in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare the ultrafast optical response of a nanoring using the semiconductor Bloch equations and our excitonic equations, where phase space filling is included. We demonstrate the potential advantages of the excitonic approach.

articleTitle: Liquid crystals based tunable high-Q directional random laser from a planar random microcavity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Temperature tunable directional laser emission from a liquid crystal based planar random cavity laser is presented. The emitted laser can be controlled as a ultra high Q factor (Q>20000) and highly directional single mode laser.

articleTitle: Temperature-stable operating current of surface plasmon VCSELs with metal nanohole arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate temperature-stable operation of 850nm AlGaAs-based VCSELs in which metal nanohole arrays are integrated as a part of top mirror. The resultant variation of the operating current from 10°C to 90°C is as small as 0.65mA at the output power of 1mW.

articleTitle: Optical pumping using chirped pulses of a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL)
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the response of a VCSEL after optical pumping using pulses with varying quadratic chirp. The data are in good agreement with a microscopic rate approximation model.

articleTitle: Broadband 2 GHz femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a 2.12 GHz prismless femtosecond Ti:sapphire ring laser with a broadband spectrum, extending from 635 to 1060 nm at -20 dB below its maximum at 680 nm, and with an average power of 0.93 W for 8 W of pump power.

articleTitle: Competition between 20th-order rational harmonic mode-locking and gain-switching in inverse optical comb injected semiconductor optical amplifier fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 20th-order rational harmonic mode-locked (RHML) pulses are demonstrated by using 1 GHz backward dark-optical comb injection semiconductor optical amplifier. A less pronounced high-order RHML mechanism than gain-switching is observed from red-shifted wavelength and reduced linewidth.

articleTitle: Optical linewidth and dephasing in single InAs quantum dots and coupled dot-microcavity systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study effects of carrier-phonon interactions on the optical spectra of single semiconductor quantum dots in etched mesas and dots imbedded in semiconductor cavities. The temperature dependence of the exciton linewidths in single dots is compared with experimental results.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic tunable filter-based spectropolarimetric imagers for biomedical applications
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical imagers that can detect both spectral and polarization signatures are needed in biomedical applications. Acousto-optic tunable filter (AOTF) based imagers are described that are ideally suited to provide both agile spectral and polarization signatures.

articleTitle: Atomic frequency references based on dark resonances in micrometric thin cells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent population trapping resonances in pure alkaline micrometric thin cells are considered as an interesting alternative for the development of miniaturized atomic frequency references. Theoretical and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Resonance fluorescence from a semiconductor quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Orthogonal optical detection and excitation of quantum dots embedded in a microcavity allows, for the first time, for background-free measurement of their resonance fluorescence. The spectra and photon statistics of single dots were obtained.

articleTitle: Quantitative phase contrast imaging of cells by multi-wavelength digital holography
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantitative phase contrast images of cells are generated by multi-wavelength phase imaging digital holography. Two or more wavelengths are used for simultaneous illumination of the cells and real-time acquisition of holographic images.

articleTitle: Linewidth broadening in single-mode sub-kHz fiber ring laser with unpumped Er-doped sagnac loop
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated a power dependent laser linewidth broadening effect in a sub-kHz single-longitudinal mode Er-doped fiber ring laser using an intra-cavity unpumped Erbium doped fiber loop.

articleTitle: Experimental decoy state quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have implemented decoy state quantum key distribution over a recordsetting 107 km of dark optical fiber in a switched interferometer phase-encoding system utilizing ultra-low-noise, high-efficiency transition-edge sensors.

articleTitle: Single photon source on demand based on single-colloidal-quantum-dot fluorescence in chiral photonic bandgap liquid crystal hosts
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single-photon source based on single CdSe quantum-dot fluorescence in a chiral-photonic-bandgap liquid-crystal host manifests itself in observed fluorescence antibunching. Chiral-photonic bandgap structures will provide deterministically handed, circular-polarized fluorescence, even for emitters without a dipole moment.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced resonant absorption in laser cooling of solids
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use an optical cavity to enhance the absorption of pump light in a laser cooling experiment. Nearly 90% pump absorption is obtained on resonance and cooling is demonstrated with Yb:ZBLAN glass.

articleTitle: Compact and robust laser system for rubidium laser cooling based on fibered technology at 1560 nm and second harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a compact and robust laser system for onboard laser cooling experiments like atomic clocks or atomic inertial sensors. Our system is based on the frequency doubling of a fiber bench at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: All-optical quasi-phase matching and quantum path control by counter propagating pulse trains
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We enhance high-order harmonic generation at 70eV in argon and 145eV in helium by orders of magnitude using counterpropagating pulsetrains. We also demonstrate coherent control on attosecond timescales by selective enhancement of different quantum trajectories.

articleTitle: Fabrication of photonic crystal by two-photon single-beam laser holographic lithography
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this report, we demonstrate the fabrication of photonic crystals by two-photon holographic lithography through a single laser beam by introducing a specially designed prism.

articleTitle: Changes in excitation line shapes due to beliaev damping in a BEC
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We quantitatively study the Beliaev decay of Bogoliubov quasi-particles of different energies and momenta in an elongated BEC. The structure of the continuum leads to a momentum dependent collisional shift of the excitation spectrum.

articleTitle: Waveguide lasers of Er:ZBLAN and Nd:GGG by pulsed laser deposition and fs-laser microstructuring
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguide lasers are manufactured using laser radiation for the deposition of thin films and the micro structuring of the wave guiding structures. For the first time laser activity in fs-laser structured amorphous waveguides was achieved.

articleTitle: Phasons and pure phason strain in nonlinear photonic quasicrystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study defect dynamics in nonlinear photonic quasicrystals, and demonstrate experimentally that phasons survive longer than phonons. We show that nonlinear interactions in photonic quasicrystals can reduce the phason strain within the structure.

articleTitle: Design and application of circular dammann grating
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel circular Dammann grating is proposed to generate uniform-intensity impulse rings corresponding to different diffraction orders in the far field. Experimental demonstration and some applications are also presented.

articleTitle: Radially polarized terahertz beam emission by difference frequency generation in GaAs
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is shown that using quasi-phase-matched GaAs crystal in the scheme of Cherenkov-type difference frequency generation allows controlling the direction of terahertz emission and by that way achieving significant increase in the output power.

articleTitle: Development of the lidar controlled-airspace scanner for bio-aerosol detection
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A standoff bio-aerosol-sensor is in prototype development and test for short range building-interior applications. It measures elastic backscatter at ultraviolet and near-infrared laser wavelengths to detect respirable aerosol clouds and measures ultraviolet fluorescence for aerosol discrimination.

articleTitle: Cascade-like nonlinearity caused by local-field effects: Extending bloembergen's result
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We treated the saturation effect in a dense medium up to the fifth order of nonlinearity, and discovered that the expression for the local-field-corrected fifth-order susceptibility disagrees with what was understood to be Bloembergen's prediction.

articleTitle: Development of a spatial light modulator with an over-two-octave bandwidth from ultraviolet to near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A spatial light phase modulator with a high transmission> 85% (260-1100 nm) and a phase modulation capability of 53 radian at 260 urn and 12 radian at 1100 nm has been developed for the first time.

articleTitle: A 355 TW femtosecond Ti:Sapphire laser facility with three stage amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser facility with three stage amplifiers was developed. By eliminating ASE and shaping spectrum, we generated 11J laser pluse at duration of 31fs, which corresponds to peak power of about 355TW.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral imaging of plasmonic excitations induced by an Electron Beam
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first realization of a hyperspectral imaging technique of surface plasmon polaritons using a scanning electron beam. The technique provides for plasmon imaging and information on decay lengths with nanometer resolution.

articleTitle: Quantum teleportation between light and matter
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

articleTitle: Transient thermal lensing at 1khz repetition rate in a cryogenically-cooled high average power Ti:sapphire Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With 2D spectral interferometry we characterize the transient thermal lensing in a liquid-nitrogen cooled cryostat designed for high thermal load. Even though the repetition rate is 1kHz, we observe substantial cooling between shots.

articleTitle: Exploring non-conservation of angular momentum in spontaneous parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an efficient method to measure the total angular momentum of the down-converted beams in the case that the angular momentum is not conserved due to azimuthal asymmetry in spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: Multimode silicon raman amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a novel multimode silicon waveguide Raman amplifier consisting of collinearly propagating pump and amplified Stokes beams with self-imaging of Stokes beam due to Talbot effect. Application of this device as image pre-amplifier is discussed.

articleTitle: Strongly nondegenerate parametric oscillations in a whispering gallery mode resonator
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate optical continuous wave parametric oscillations in crystalline whispering gallery mode (WGM) resonators fabricated with LiNb03. The required phase matching is achieved by geometrical confinement of the WGMs.

articleTitle: Spatially shaping the longitudinal focal distribution into a horseshoe-shaped profile
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel three-dimensional laser focus, with a horseshoe-shaped longitudinal intensity profile, was realized experimentally from a single laser beam by the incoherent coaxial combination of Laguerre-Gaussian and Gaussian modes generated from segmented optical elements.

articleTitle: Violation of Bell's inequality with continuous spatial variables
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an approach to violating Bell's inequality with the continuous spatial variables of entangled-photon pairs using simple optical components that manipulate the spatial parity of the transverse coordinate in one dimension.

articleTitle: Highly efficient and compact green VECSEL by novel optical end-pumping scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the development and demonstration of the watt-level operation of a compact green vertical external cavity surface emitting laser optically end-pumped by a single chip laser diode without any focusing lenses.

articleTitle: Possible evidence for a mobility edge for photons in two dimensions
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have applied a renormalization group analysis to the study of Anderson localization of light in 2D disordered PCs. Contrary to common belief, we find possible evidence of a mobility edge in two dimensions.

articleTitle: Above room-temperature operation of InAs/AlSb quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Above room temperature operation of InAs/AlSb quantum cascade lasers emitting at around 6 μm are reported. The emission originates from the vertical transition in double quantum wells. The threshold current in pulsed mode is 5.3 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 300 K and maximum operating temperature is 373 K.

articleTitle: Theory of optical gain from four-wave mixing instabilities in quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict that in a typical pump-probe setup four-wave mixing instabilities associated with biexcitonic correlations in a single semiconductor quantum well can yield large optical gain in the probe and background-free four-wave mixing directions.

articleTitle: Observation of subluminal and superluminal regimes in coupled mode optical propagation
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Attraction and repulsion of coupled modes with swinging subluminal and superluminal group velocity is directly observed, for the first time, at optical frequencies. The measurement technique combines polarization-sensitive low-coherence interferometry with light trapping in a ring-resonator.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical probe of a singly-charged stranski-krastanow quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate coherent nonlinear response from a singly-charged self assembled quantum dot. A degenerate differential transmission spectrum shows carrier tunneling, leading to a Fano profile.

articleTitle: A volume Bragg grating locked Nd:fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Neodymium doped LMA fiber is locked with a volume Bragg grating for the first time, and compared to a conventional fiber laser setup. The efficiency is improved and the linewidth is drastically reduced.

articleTitle: Transition between rydberg 1s and 2p exciton states of biexcitons in semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In CuCl quantum dots, we have measured transient absorption spectra attributed mainly to transition from Rydberg 1s to 2p states of excitons and biexcitons, respectively. The dot size dependence of their transition energies is observed.

articleTitle: Rare event simulation of the performance of an actively mode-locked fiber laser model
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the application of importance sampling to Monte Carlo simulations of an actively mode-locked laser model. The method computes the probability of errors due to both amplitude drop-outs and pulse position shifts.

articleTitle: Electra: An electron beam pumped 730 J rep-rate KrF laser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electra has operated in oscillator mode for multi-thousand shot runs continuously at 1, 2.5 and 5 Hz. The Electra single pass pre-amplifier produces 23 Joules and is being incorporated into the laser system.

articleTitle: Optical-fiber-based probing of semiconductor microcavity-quantum-dot systems at cryogenic temperatures
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrasmall volume (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub>~ 2 - 6(λ)/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3<sup> microdisks with embedded quantum dots are studied at cryogenic temperatures through an optical lilx:r taper waVeguide probe, and high-resolution cavity mode wavelength tuning by nitrogen gas adsorption is investigated.</sup></sup>

articleTitle: Laser cooling in solids
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser cooling in optical solids can lead to the realization of all-solid state cryocoolers. We present new results on Yb- and Tm-doped glasses and crystals and describe progress toward achieving net cooling in GaAs heterostructures.

articleTitle: Linear, spatio-temporal characterization of UV microscope objectives for nonlinear imaging and spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral interferometry coupled to numerical wave propagation is used to extract the spatial and temporal characteristics of an ultraviolet objective used for nonlinear imaging and spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Modeling sub-nanosecond pulsed laser dynamics using the exponential time difference method
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The authors show that the exponential time difference method is orders of magnitude faster than the standard finite difference time domain method to model the dynamics of longitudinally pumped sub-nanosecond pulsed dye lasers.

articleTitle: Unconditionally secure one-way quantum key distribution using decoy pulses
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental one-way decoy quantum key distribution (QKD) is reported as a function of distance up to 25.3km. The high key rates obtained exceed one order of magnitude more than QKD performed without decoy pulse exchange.

articleTitle: Ultrafast radiative decay of confined excitons due to long-range coherent coupling with radiation wave
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transient grating spectrum and the delay time dependence are investigated in a CuCl thin film. The structures for complex eigenmodes and the ultrafast radiative decay rates of excitons below 200 fs are observed.

articleTitle: Determination of interband transition dipole moment of InAs/InGaAs quantum dots from modal absorption spectra
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interband-transition dipole moment of InAs/InGaAs quantum dots is determined for the first time by the segmented-modal-absorption method. The extracted dipole moment near 1.3_μm wavelength is 32±2 Debye consistent with those reported in the literature.

articleTitle: Isolated attosecond pulses in the few-cycle regime
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the generation of isolated attosecond pulses using phase-stabilized 5-fs pulses with time dependent ellipticity. Using a complete temporal characterization technique, we demonstrate compression of the pulses down to 130 as (<1.2 optical cycles).

articleTitle: Threshold analysis of longitudinal modes in surface emitting organic distributed feedback lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present theoretical analysis of the mode discrimination and threshold gain of multiple longitudinal modes observed from a surface-emitting organic DFB laser. Based on the individual pumping threshold energy, the corresponding extraction ratio is estimated.

articleTitle: Phases of a fermi gas with unequal spin populations
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have produced a two-component gas of ultracold, fermionic 6Li atoms with unequal spin populations. The real-space densities reveal two distinct superfluid phases, both with an evenly paired central core.

articleTitle: The Application of laser-driven acoustic waves in modern mass spectrometry
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of the acoustic vibration of laser back-irradiated thin metal foils and their influence on desorption of organic molecules from the foil's front surface were studied. The possible mechanisms of this phenomenon are discussed.

articleTitle: LT-GaAsSb photomixer for THz generation with a two-color Nd:LSB microchiplaser
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photomixing is performed with a novel two-color Nd:LSB laser that simultaneously emits at 1061.3 nm and 1063.9 nm in LT-GaAsSb antennas.

articleTitle: A fiber-coupled eye safe spectrometer for the stand-off detection of explosives
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact laser spectrometer for the detection of explosives from a safe spot is presented. This laser setup also opens the possibility for the trace detection of explosives.

articleTitle: Quantum effects in non linear optics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical non linear interactions changing the statistics of a light field are often counteracted by dissipative processes. Artificial structuring of the non linear medium can reduce dissipation and enhance the effect of the non linearity.

articleTitle: In vivo Imaging Using Harmonic Generation Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With a virtual-transition characteristic, harmonic generation microscopy provides high-penetration non-invasive intravital optical images with a submicron 3D resolution, ideal for in vivo disease diagnoses and longterm live animal studies.

articleTitle: Observation of long-lived screening in low-temperature-grown GaAs photoconductive switches
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A subgroup of photoexcited carriers in biased few-μm-sized LT-GaAs switches is shown to recombine on a time scale of nanoseconds. This can induce field screening amounting to tens of percent of the applied field.

articleTitle: Identification in the frequency domain of molecular dissociation fragments detected by a wavepacket
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent control of Rb2 predissociation by chirped femtosecond laser pulses is detected by a wavepacket probe. Specific atomic fragments of molecular dissociation are identified by viewing the wavepacket dynamics in the spectral domain.

articleTitle: Entanglement and rapid measurement of clock-state qubits in Yb or Sr for quantum information processing
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We devise protocols for entangling and rapidly measuring qubits encoded in the clock transitions in Yb or Sr. Our work provides concrete guidelines for experimental realizations of quantum computing and fundamental tests of quantum mechanics.

articleTitle: Metal strips and wires as plasmonic waveguides for integrated-optics components
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Propagation of long-range surface plasmon polaritons in different waveguide components based on nm-thin and μm-wide metal strips and symmetrical sub-wavelength metal nanowires embedded in a uniform dielectric is experimentally studied at telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: Velocity-selective two-photon resonances with blue and red detunings in a cold atomic sample
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore a cooling mechanism that results from a two-photon Raman process resonant with a particular velocity class of atoms. We have seen evidence for cooling with both red and blue detuned light.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of L-Band to S-Band wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 50-nm optical wavelength conversion based on the potentially noise-free Bragg scattering process in an optical fiber is demonstrated experimentally. 2.5-Gb/s output waveforms and eye diagrams for the initial and converted signal are presented.

articleTitle: Cross-correlations and entanglement in a cavity QED system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the cross-correlation between transmitted light out of a cavity QED system and spontaneous emission into the orthogonal polarization cavity mode. The result is an entanglement witness between the two modes of the cavity.

articleTitle: Pulse shape control of a high-energy PW laser for fast ignition of laser fusion
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A laser-pulse shaping system of a high-energy PW laser has been developed for fast ignition of laser fusion. We have demonstrated flat-top pulses of 10ps with a rise time of 1 ps.

articleTitle: Integrated optics technology for quantum information processing in atomic systems
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Scalable quantum information processing in ion traps or neutral atoms requires highly integrated and functional optical systems for qubit manipulation and detection. We discuss and demonstrate integrated optics technologies that are relevant for this application.

articleTitle: THz phase-transition spectroscopy of metals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz (THz) time-domain spectroscopy is employed to study the solid-liquid phase transition of metallic Ga particle collections. This work is the first non-invasive THz spectroscopic investigation of melting phenomena in metallic media.

articleTitle: Direct visualization of stationary interference patterns of several running whispering gallery modes
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the direct observation of stationary interference patterns of several running optical whispering gallery modes in an experiment with a fused silica microsphere immersed into a dye solution.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation from integrated nonlinearities in two-wavelength quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Evidence for Difference Frequency Generation in Quantum Cascade Lasers with integrated nonlinearities is presented. Light at the difference frequency (λ = 13.3μm) is detected from a twowavelength (λ = 5.3μm and 8.8μm) laser processed with a splitridge configuration.

articleTitle: Superluminal Brillouin amplification for sub-cycle interactions of modulated light
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Superluminal Brillouin amplification is predicted and demonstrated for modulated pump and Stokes waves, for interaction lengths less than half the modulation wavelength. The group velocity increases by a factor ≈ G , the Brillouin exponential gain parameter.

articleTitle: Power scaling of laser systems using spectral beam combining with volume Bragg gratings in PTR glass
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser system power can be increased using volume Bragg gratings in PTR glass to combine multiple beams into a near-diffraction-limited beam. We present results of combining five fiber lasers and show achievability of multi-kW-level systems.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation driven by local field asymmetry in noncentrosymmetric gold Nano-Ts
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that second-harmonic generation from noncentrosymmetric gold nano-Ts with nanogaps is governed by asymmetric distribution of the local fundamental field, and not strictly according to field enhancement in small nanogaps.

articleTitle: Low-loss splicing small-core photonic crystal fibers and single-mode fibers by repeated arc discharges
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated low-loss splicing small-core photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) and single-mode fibers by repeated arc discharges applied over the splicing joint to gradually collapse the air holes of the small-core PCF.

articleTitle: Optode design on flexible print circuit board for a portable diffuse optical tomography system
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optode scheme of DOT is designed for tissue oxygenation probing. The multiplexing illumination and image acquisition are operated with DAQ card interface. In experiments, the hemodynamic images are observed with in vivo measurements.

articleTitle: The quantum noise limits to simultaneous intensity and frequency stabilization of solid-state lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We incorporate the coupling between pump intensity and laser frequency noise into a quantum mechanical model for a solid-state laser. A frequency feedback loop can reduce laser intensity noise to below the quantum noise limit.

articleTitle: Toward all semiconductor quantum repeaters
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Deterministic quantum state transfer from a photonic qubit to an electron spin qubit is crucial for building all semiconductor quantum repeaters. We present the coherent state preparation of electron spins imprinted from the photon polarization.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of circular, elliptical and rectangular (fishnet) negative index metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Negative index materials consisting of Au-Al2O3-Au films with a 2D array of apertures have been fabricated. Circular, elliptical and rectangular apertures are compared. Comparable figures of merit [-Re(n)/Im(n)] are observed for all three geometries.

articleTitle: Negative bi-exciton binding energy in (211)B InAs/GaAs piezoelectric quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on isolated dot spectroscopy of polar (211)InAs/GaAs quantum dots grown by MBE. Exciton and biexciton peaks have been identified, revealing a negative biexciton binding energy attributed to the presence of strong piezoelectric field.

articleTitle: Exact modeling of generalised defect modes in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an exact method for modeling modes of general defects with infinite cladding. It handles the pathological case of highly extended modes and establishes the fundamental mode of a conventional PCF has no cutoff.

articleTitle: Observation of interferometric autocorrelation trace of an attosecond pulse train
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the direct observation of phase locking between adjacent pulses in an attosecond pulse train via interferometric autocorrelation, using the Coulomb explosion of N2 caused by two-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Fabrication of PPLT crystal fiber by the method of laser heated pedestal growth
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The fabrication of a periodic poled Lithium Tantalate single crystal fibers were firstly achieved in-situ via the laser heated pedestal growth method. The spectrum of second harmonic generation was characterized.

articleTitle: Optical parametric amplification of optical pulses with a nearly one-octave bandwidth from a hollow fiber
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed an angularly dispersed noncollinear optical parametric amplifier with a 300-THz bandwidth (550 - 1000 nm) for the first time. To the best of our knowledge, this is the broadest parametric gain.

articleTitle: Temporally focused pulses and coherent control for nonlinear microscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear microscopy with femtosecond lasers is enhanced by pulse shaping using concepts of coherent control. We review some of these ideas, including the replacement of spatial scanning by temporal focusing.

articleTitle: Application of near field optical microscopy to the study of femtosecond laser micro-structured Nd:YAG crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The micro-structural modifications induced by lemtosecond laser ablation of Nd:YAG crystals has been studied by Near Field Optical Microscopy, Results have been compared to those obtained from micro-luminescence experiments.

articleTitle: Double nanohole-enhanced Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The cusps formed by two barely overlapping nanoholes in a metal film enhance the local field and allow for order of magnitude surface-enhanced Raman over single holes.

articleTitle: Free spectral range matched scanning interrogator
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A free spectral range matched scanning interrogator has been proposed and demonstrated with an ultra high wavelength resolution of 5pm. This system has great applications for wavelength-modulated distributed sensors and multiple temperature/stress sensor arrays.

articleTitle: Light emission from size reduced nanocrystal silicon quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed HF treatment to silicon quantum dots with diameter of 8nm±1nm fabricated by VHF plasma decomposition process. We observed PL wavelength shift from 750nm to 620nm for 8nm to 2.5nm diameter nc-Si dots.

articleTitle: Multiterawatt three-cycle optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical parametric chirped pulse amplification is one of the most promising techniques for the amplification of few-cycle pulses. We show amplification and compression to the multiterawatt level of near transform-limited three-optical-cycle pulses.

articleTitle: Three wave interaction in negative refractive index materials with quadratic nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examine waves propagation in negative refractive index materials with quadratic nonlinearity. We analyze the modulational instability of the wave with constant background. The solitary wave solutions binding pump and second harmonic waves are found.

articleTitle: Er:Yb-doped waveguide amplifier fabricated in oxyfluoride silicate glass using femtosecond laser inscription
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report for the first time, net gain from a channel waveguide fabricated in Er:Yb doped oxyfluoride silicate glass using femtosecond waveguide inscription. Waveguides were fabricated using the multi-scan technique to control the waveguide cross-section.

articleTitle: Experimental measurement of the dispersion relations of gold nanoparticle chains
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dispersion relations of plasmon modes of gold nanoparticle chains are measured, and compared with quasistatic theory. In addition to one longitudinal and one transverse mode, the results reveal a third mode, not previously observed.

articleTitle: SOI ridge waveguide incorporating a photonic crystal microcavity multi-channel filter
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A one-dimensional photonic crystal microcavity filter that transmits light simultaneously at several wavelengths has been designed and fabricated. Transmission peaks occurred at 1168, 1321 and 1562 nm wavelengths, meeting the design specification.

articleTitle: Pulse Limiting Amplification by Saturation Effects in an SOA
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the limiting-amplification capability of a saturated SOA followed by an optical filter in case of amplitude-modulated 20GHz pulses. We report more than 25 dB amplitude-modulation-reduction for input modulating frequencies in the range 100KHz-3GHz.

articleTitle: Localization by random apertures in a metal film
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The transmission through random subwavelength rectangular apertures in a gold film is studied. Enhanced loss is shown to arise from localization of light at the surface of the film, which increases with aperture density.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics in zinc-porphyrin microcavities
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on ultrafast dynamics of polaritons in organic microcavities. Polariton dynamics is found to be governed by fast vibronic relaxation and intersystem crossing. Lower polariton branch blue-shift indicates the presence of nonlinear interactions.

articleTitle: THz modulation of relativistic electrons using a vacuum laser beat-wave
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is proposed to modulate electrons longitudinally by the ponderomotive force of a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser beat-wave. For the 9.3 and 10.6 μtm laser lines, the beam injected into the undulator radiates at ~ 77 μm.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear optics of light harvesting complexes: TCL- and Bloch Equations for linear spectra and saturation dynamics
publicationTitle: 2007 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
